1
直省水利
Water Conservancy in the Directly Administered Provinces
2
三代疆理水土之制甚詳。 自井田廢，溝遂堙，水常不得其治，於是穿鑿渠塘井陂，以資灌溉。 明初，太祖詔所在有司，民以水利條上者，即陳奏。 越二十七年，特諭工部，陂塘湖堰可蓄泄以備旱潦者，皆因其地勢修治之。 乃分遣國子生及人材，遍詣天下，督修水利。 明年冬，郡邑交奏。 凡開塘堰四萬九百八十七處，其恤民者至矣。 嗣後有所興築，或役本境，或資鄰封，或支官料，或採山場，或農隙鳩工，或隨時集事，或遣大臣董成。 終明世水政屢修，可具列云。
The Three Dynasties had elaborate institutions for surveying land and regulating water and soil. Once the well-field system fell away and ditches and drains silted shut, water could seldom be brought under proper control, so people bored and cut canals, ponds, wells, and embankments to irrigate their fields. Early in the Ming, Taizu ordered officials in every locality to forward at once any waterworks proposals the people submitted. Twenty-seven years on, he expressly told the Ministry of Works to repair every pond, lake, and dam that could hold or release water against drought and flood, each according to the lay of the land. He then sent out Imperial Academy students and talented men across the realm to oversee hydraulic works. The following winter, prefectures and counties filed their reports one after another. In all, 40,987 ponds and dams were opened—a measure of care for the people that could hardly be surpassed. Later projects might conscript labor locally or draw help from neighboring districts, issue official supplies or quarry mountain materials, muster workers in farming slack seasons or assemble them as need arose, and sometimes a senior minister was sent to supervise the work through to completion. Waterworks were repaired again and again through the Ming; the main undertakings may be set out as follows.
3
洪武元年修和州銅城堰閘，週迴二百餘里。 四年修興安靈渠，為陡渠者三十六。 渠水發海陽山，秦時鑿，溉田萬頃。 馬援葺之，後圮。 至是始復。 六年發松江、嘉興民夫二萬開上海胡家港，自海口至漕涇千二百餘丈，以通海船，且浚海鹽澉浦。 八年開登州蓬萊閣河。 命耿炳文浚涇陽洪渠堰，溉涇陽、三原、醴泉、高陵、臨潼田二百餘里。 九年修彭州都江堰。 十二年，李文忠言：「陝西病鹹鹵，請穿渠城中，遙引龍首渠東注。 」從其請，甃以石。 十四年築海鹽海塘。 十七年築磁州漳河決堤。 決荊州嶽山壩以灌民田。 十九年築長樂海堤。 二十三年修崇明、海門決堤二萬三千九百餘丈，役夫二十五萬人。 四川永甯宣慰使言：「所轄水道百九十灘，江門大灘八十二，皆被石塞。 」詔景川侯曹震往疏之。 二十四年修臨海橫山嶺水閘，寧海、奉化海堤四千三百餘丈。 築上虞海堤四千丈，改建石閘。 浚定海、鄞二縣東錢湖，灌田數萬頃。 二十五年鑿溧陽銀墅東壩河道，由十字港抵沙子河胭脂壩四千三百餘丈，役夫三十五萬九千餘人。 二十七年浚山陽支家河，鬱林州民言：「州南北二江相去二十餘里，乞鑿通，設石陡諸閘。 」從之。 二十九年修築河南洛堤。 復興安靈渠。 時尚書唐鐸以軍興至其地，圖渠狀以聞。 請浚深廣，通官舟以餉軍。 命御史嚴震直燒鑿陡澗之石，餉道果通。 三十一年，洪渠堰圮，復命耿炳文修治之。 且浚渠十萬三千餘丈。 建文四年疏吳淞江。
Hongwu 1 (1368): the Tongcheng Dam sluice in He Prefecture was repaired, enclosing more than two hundred li of land. Hongwu 4: the Ling Canal at Xing'an was repaired, with thirty-six stepped channels built. Its water rises on Haiyang Mountain; the Qin had cut the channel, which irrigated ten thousand qing of fields. Ma Yuan had restored it, but it later fell into ruin. Only now was it brought back into use. Hongwu 6: twenty thousand laborers from Songjiang and Jiaxing opened Hujia Harbor at Shanghai—more than 1,200 zhang from the estuary to Caojing—to admit seagoing craft, and the salt port of Ganpu was dredged as well. Hongwu 8: the river at Penglai Pavilion in Dengzhou was opened. Geng Bingwen was ordered to dredge the Hong Canal dam at Jingyang, watering more than two hundred li of fields in Jingyang, Sanyuan, Liquan, Gaoling, and Lintong. Hongwu 9: the Dujiangyan works at Pengzhou were repaired. Hongwu 12: Li Wenzhong memorialized, 'Shaanxi is plagued by brackish soil; I ask permission to cut a canal through the city and bring the Longshou Canal in from the east.' The request was granted, and the channel was lined with stone. Hongwu 14: the seawall at Haiyan was built. Hongwu 17: the breached Zhang River dike at Cizhou was repaired. The Yueshan Dam in Jingzhou was opened to water the people's fields. Hongwu 19: the coastal dike at Changle was built. Hongwu 23: more than 23,900 zhang of breached dikes at Chongming and Haimen were repaired, with 250,000 workers employed. The Pacification Commissioner of Yongning in Sichuan reported, 'Within my jurisdiction are 190 shoals on the waterways, including 82 major ones at Jiangmen, all choked with rock.' The court ordered Marquis Cao Zhen of Jingchuan to go and clear them. Hongwu 24: the sluice at Hengshan Ridge in Linhai was repaired, and more than 4,300 zhang of sea dikes at Ninghai and Fenghua. A four-thousand-zhang sea dike was built at Shangyu, and the stone sluice was rebuilt. East Qian Lake in Dinghai and Yin counties was dredged, watering tens of thousands of qing of fields. Hongwu 25: the channel at the eastern dam of Yinshu in Liyang was cut—more than 4,300 zhang from Shizi Harbor to the Yanzhi Dam on the Shazi River—with 359,000-odd workers employed. Hongwu 27: Zhijia River in Shanyang was dredged; the people of Yulin Prefecture petitioned, 'The north and south rivers of the prefecture lie more than twenty li apart; we ask that they be cut through and linked, with stone locks and other gates installed.' The request was granted. Hongwu 29: the Luo River dike in Henan was built up. The Ling Canal at Xing'an was restored again. Minister Tang Duo happened to reach the place on military business, surveyed the canal, and memorialized with a diagram. He asked that it be dredged deep and wide so government transports could supply the army. Censor Yan Zhenzhi was ordered to burn and cut through the rock of the steep gorges, and the supply route was duly opened. Hongwu 31: the Hong Canal dam collapsed, and Geng Bingwen was again ordered to repair it. More than 103,000 zhang of the canal were dredged as well. Jianwen 4 (1402): the Wusong River was dredged.
4
命夏原吉治蘇、鬆、嘉興水患，浚華亭、上海運鹽河，金山衛閘及漕涇分水港。 原吉言：「浙西諸郡，蘇、鬆最居下流，嘉、湖、常頗高，環乙太湖，綿亙五百里。 納杭、湖、宣、歙溪澗之水，散注澱山諸湖，以入三泖。 頃為浦港堙塞，漲溢害稼。 拯治之法，在浚吳淞諸浦。 按吳淞江袤二百餘里，廣百五十餘丈，西接太湖，東通海，前代常疏之。 然當潮汐之沖，旋疏旋塞。 自吳江長橋抵下界浦，百二十餘里，水流雖通，實多窄淺。 從浦抵上海南倉浦口，百三十餘里，潮汐淤塞，已成平陸，氵豔沙遊泥，難以施工。 嘉定劉家港即古婁江，徑入海，常熟白茆港徑入江，皆廣川急流。 宜疏吳淞南北兩岸、安亭等浦，引太湖諸水入劉家、白茆二港，使其勢分。 松江大黃浦乃通吳淞要道，今下流遏塞難浚。 旁有範家浜，至南倉浦口徑達海。 宜浚深闊，上接大黃浦，達泖湖之水，庶幾復《禹貢》「三江入海「之舊。 水道既通，乃相地勢，各置石閘，以時啟閉。 每歲水涸時，預修圩岸，以防暴流，則水患可息。 」帝命發民丁開浚。 原吉晝夜徙步，以身先之，功遂成。
Xia Yuanji was ordered to deal with flooding in Suzhou, Songjiang, and Jiaxing, and to dredge the salt transport rivers of Huating and Shanghai, the Jinshan Guard sluice, and the Caojing distributary. Yuanji reported, 'Of the prefectures in western Zhejiang, Suzhou and Songjiang lie lowest downstream, while Jiaxing, Huzhou, and Changzhou stand higher, all ringing Lake Tai across five hundred li.' It takes in streams from Hangzhou, Huzhou, Xuancheng, and Shezhou, channels them through lakes such as Dianshan, and sends them on into the Three Mo. Lately the estuary channels have silted shut, and the backed-up water has ruined the crops. The remedy is to dredge the Wusong and its tributary channels. The Wusong River runs more than two hundred li and is over 150 zhang wide, joining Lake Tai on the west and the sea on the east; earlier dynasties dredged it regularly. Yet it lies in the path of the tides, so no sooner is it cleared than it silts up again. From Chang Bridge in Wujiang to Xiajie Harbor—a stretch of more than 120 li—the water flows, but much of the channel is narrow and shallow. From that harbor to Nancang Harbor at Shanghai—another 130-odd li—tidal silt has choked the channel until it is level ground, a mass of wandering mud and sand on which work can scarcely proceed. Liujia Harbor in Jiading is the ancient Lou River and runs straight to the sea; Ba Mao Harbor in Changshu runs straight into the Yangtze—both are broad, swift channels. The Wusong's north and south banks and channels such as Anting should be dredged to divert Lake Tai's waters into Liujia and Ba Mao harbors and split the flow. Songjiang's Great Huangpu is the main route to the Wusong, but its lower reach is now blocked and hard to dredge. Beside it lies Fanjia Creek, which from Nancang Harbor runs straight to the sea. It should be dredged deep and wide, linked above to the Great Huangpu and below to the Mo lakes, so that the Yu Gong's old pattern of 'the Three Rivers entering the sea' might be restored. Once the waterways are open, stone locks should be set at suitable points and opened or closed according to the season. Each year, when the water runs low, the polder banks should be repaired in advance against sudden floods, and the flooding will abate. The emperor ordered laborers mobilized for the dredging. Yuanji tramped the works day and night, leading in person, until the project was finished.
5
二年，修泰州河塘萬八千丈，興化南北堤、泰興沿江圩岸、六合瓜步等屯。 浚丹徒通潮舊江，又修象山茭湖塘岸，海康、徐聞二縣那隱坡、調黎等港堤岸，黃嚴混水等十五閘、六陡門，孟津河堤，分宜湖塘，武陟馬田堤岸，香山竹徑水陂，復興安分水塘。 興安有江，源出海陽山。 江中橫築石埭，分南北渠，溉民田甚溥。 埭上疊石如鱗，以防沖溢。 嚴震直撤石增埭，水迫無所泄，沖塘岸，盡趨北渠，南渠淺澀，民失利。 至是修復如舊。
Yongle 2: 18,000 zhang of river embankments in Taizhou were repaired, along with the north and south dikes of Xinghua, Taixing's riverside polders, and the Guabu garrison lands in Luhe. The old tidal channel at Dantu was dredged; embankments were also repaired at Jiaohu in Xiangshan, harbor dikes at Nayinpo and Diaoli in Haikang and Xuwen, fifteen locks including Hunshui in Huangyan and six stepped gates, the Mengjin River dike, Fenyi's lake embankment, Wuzhi's Matian dike, Xiangshan's Zhujing water dam, and Xing'an's Fen Shui embankment. At Xing'an a river rises on Haiyang Mountain. A stone weir built across the river divides north and south channels and waters a great expanse of farmland. Stones were laid on the weir like fish scales to withstand the rush of floodwater. Yan Zhenzhi had removed the stones and raised the weir; with nowhere for the water to spill, it battered the pond banks and poured entirely into the north channel, leaving the south channel shallow and sluggish and the people worse off. It was now restored to its former condition.
6
海門民請發淮安、蘇、常民丁協修張墩港、東明港百餘里潰堤。 帝曰：「三郡民方苦水患，不可重勞。 」遣官行視，以揚州民協築之。 當塗民言：「慈湖瀕江，上通宣、歙，東抵丹陽湖，西接蕪湖。 久雨浸淫，潮漲傷農，宜遣勘修築。 」帝從其請，且諭工部，安、徽、蘇、鬆，浙江、江西、湖廣，凡湖泊卑下，圩岸傾頹，亟督有司治之。 夏原吉復奉命治水蘇、鬆，盡通舊河港。 又浚蘇州千墩浦、致和塘、安亭、顧浦、陸皎浦、尤涇、黃涇共二萬九千餘丈，松江大黃浦、赤雁浦、範家浜共萬二千丈，以通太湖下流。
The people of Haimen asked that laborers from Huai'an, Suzhou, and Changzhou be sent to help repair more than a hundred li of breached dikes at Zhangdun and Dongming harbors. The emperor said, 'The people of those three prefectures are already suffering from flooding; they must not be burdened again.' He sent officials to inspect the site and had Yangzhou laborers assist in the repairs. The people of Dangtu reported, 'Cihu lies on the river, linking upstream to Xuancheng and Shezhou, east to Danyang Lake, and west to Wuhu.' Prolonged rain has soaked the land, and rising tides have harmed the crops; officials should be sent to survey and repair the works. The emperor granted the request and also told the Ministry of Works to press officials in Anhui, Suzhou, Songjiang, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, and Huguang to repair at once every low-lying lake and collapsed polder bank. Xia Yuanji was again ordered to manage the waters of Suzhou and Songjiang and fully reopen the old channels. He also dredged more than 29,000 zhang at Qiandun Harbor, Zhihe Pond, Anting, Gupu, Lujiaopu, Youjing, and Huangjing in Suzhou, and 12,000 zhang at the Great Huangpu, Chiyan Harbor, and Fanjia Creek in Songjiang, to restore Lake Tai's lower outflow.
7
先是，修含山崇義堰。 未幾，和州民言：「銅城閘上抵巢湖，下揚子江，決圩岸七十餘處，乞修治。 」其吏目張良興又言：「水淹麻、澧二湖田五萬餘頃，宜築圩埂，起桃花橋，訖含山界三十里。 」俱從之。
Earlier the Chongyi Dam at Hanshan had been repaired. Before long the people of He Prefecture reported, 'The Tongcheng sluice reaches Chaohu upstream and the Yangtze downstream; polder banks have breached in more than seventy places—we ask that they be repaired.' Its clerical officer Zhang Liangxing added, 'Floodwaters have submerged more than 50,000 qing of fields on the Ma and Li lakes; polder embankments should be built from Taohua Bridge to the Hanshan border for thirty li.' Both requests were granted.
8
三年，修上虞曹娥江壩埂，溫縣馱塢村堤堰四千餘丈，南海衛蓮塘、四會縣鴉鵲水等堤岸，無為州周興等鄉及鷹揚衛烏江屯江岸。 築昌黎及曆城小清河決堤，應天新河口北岸，從大勝關抵江東驛三千三百丈。 浚海州北舊河，上通高橋，下接臨洪場及山陽運鹽河十八里。
Yongle 3: the Cao'e River dam at Shangyu was repaired; more than 4,000 zhang of dikes at Tuowu Village in Wen County; dikes at Liantang in Nanhai Guard and Yaque Water in Sihui; and river banks at Zhouxing township in Wuwei and the Wujiang garrison of Yingyang Guard. Breached dikes on the Xiaoqing River at Changli and Licheng were repaired; 3,300 zhang of north bank at Xinkouhe in Yingtian, from Dasheng Pass to Jiangdong Post. The old river north of Haizhou was dredged, linking Gaoqiao upstream to Linhong Station and eighteen li of the Shanyang salt transport river downstream.
9
四年，修築宣城十九圩，豐城穆湖圩岸，石首臨江萬石堤，溧水決圩。 修懷寧鬥潭河、彭灘圩岸，順天固安，保定荊岱，樂亭魯家套、社河口，吉水劉家塘、雲陂，江都劉家圩港。 築湖廣廣濟、武家穴等江岸。 新建石頭岡圩岸、江浦沿江堤。 開泰州運鹽河、普定秦潼河、西溪南儀阡三處河口，導流興化、鹽城界入海。 浚常熟福山塘三十六里。
Yongle 4: the nineteen polders of Xuancheng were repaired, the Mu Lake polder at Fengcheng, the Wanshi riverside dike at Shishou, and breached polders at Lishui. Dou Pond River and the Pengtan polder at Huaining were repaired, along with Gu'an in Shuntian, Jingdai in Baoding, Lujiatuo and Shehekou in Leting, Liujiatang and Yunpo in Jishui, and Liujia polder harbor in Jiangdu. River banks at Guangji and Wujiaxue in Huguang were built up. New polder banks at Shitougang and the riverside dike at Jiangpu were constructed. The Taizhou salt transport river was opened, and the mouths of the Qintong River at Puding and Nan Yiqian at Xixi—three outlets in all—to carry water from the Xinghua–Yancheng border to the sea. Fushan Pond at Changshu was dredged for thirty-six li.
10
五年，修長洲、吳江、崑山、華亭、錢塘、仁和、嘉興堤岸，餘姚南湖壩，築高要銀岡、金山等潰堤，溉田五百餘頃。 治杭州江岸之淪者。 六年浚浙江平陽縣河。 七年修安陸州渲馬灘決岸、海鹽石堤，築泰興攔江堤三千九百餘丈。 且浚大港北淤河，抵縣南，出大江，四千五百餘丈。 八年修丹陽練湖塘，汝陽汝河堤岸，南陵野塘圩、蚌蕩壩，鬆滋張家坑、何家洲堤岸，平度州濰水、浮糠河決口百十二，堤堰八千餘丈，吳江石塘官路橋樑。
Yongle 5: dikes at Changzhou, Wujiang, Kunshan, Huating, Qiantang, Renhe, and Jiaxing were repaired; the south lake dam at Yuyao; breached dikes at Yingang and Jinshan in Gaoyao were built up, watering more than 500 qing of fields. Collapsed stretches of Hangzhou's river bank were repaired. Yongle 6: the river in Pingyang County, Zhejiang, was dredged. Yongle 7: the breached bank at Xuanma Beach in Anlu and the stone dike at Haiyan were repaired; a river-blocking dike of more than 3,900 zhang was built at Taixing. The silted north branch of Dagang was also dredged south of the county to the great river for more than 4,500 zhang. Yongle 8: Lianhu Pond at Danyang, the Ru River bank at Ruyang, the Yetang polder and Bangdang Dam at Nanling, dikes at Zhangjiakeng and Hejiazhou in Songzi, 112 breaches on the Weishui and Fukang rivers at Pingdu and more than 8,000 zhang of dikes and dams, and the stone-paved official road bridges at Wujiang.
11
九年，修安福丁陂等塘堰，安仁鐃家陂、壽光堤，安陸京山景陵圩岸，長樂官塘，長洲至嘉興石土塘橋路七十餘里，泄水洞百三十一處，監利車水堤四千四百餘丈，高安華陂屯陂堤，仁和、海寧、海鹽土石塘岸萬餘丈。 築沂州沭河口決岸，並瀹述陽述河。 。 築直隸新城張村等口決堤，仁和黃濠塘岸三百餘丈，孫家圍塘岸二十餘里。 浚濰縣幹丹河、定襄故渠六十三里，引滹沱水灌田六百餘頃。 疏福山官渠，浚江陰青陽河道，鄒平白條溝河三十餘里。
Yongle 9: ponds and dams including Dingpi at Anfu, Raojia Dam at Anren, and the Shouguang dike; polder banks at Jingshan and Jingling in Anlu; the official pond at Changle; more than seventy li of stone and earth roads and bridges from Changzhou to Jiaxing; 131 drainage culverts; more than 4,400 zhang of water-lifting dikes at Jianli; the Huapi garrison dam at Gao'an; and more than 10,000 zhang of earthen and stone embankments at Renhe, Haining, and Haiyan. The breached bank at the Shu River mouth in Yizhou was repaired, and the Shuyang River was dredged as well. . Breached dikes at Zhangcun and other openings in Xincheng, Zhili, were repaired; more than 300 zhang of Huanghao embankment at Renhe; and more than twenty li of Sunjiawei embankment. Gandan River in Wei County and sixty-three li of the old channel at Dingxiang were dredged to bring Hutuo water to more than 600 qing of fields. The official canal at Fushan was cleared, the Qingyang River channel at Jiangyin was dredged, and more than thirty li of the Baitiao Ditch River at Zouping.
12
麗水民言：「縣有通濟渠，截鬆陽、遂昌諸溪水入焉。 上、中、下三源，流四十八派，溉田二千餘頃。 上源民泄水自利，下源流絕，沙壅渠塞。 請修堤堰如舊。 」部議從之。 齊東知縣張升言：「小清河洪水沖決，淹沒諸鹽場及青州田。 請浚上流，修長堤，使水行故道。 」皇太子遣官經理之。 鄜州民言：「洛水橫決而西，沖塌州城東北隅。 請浚故道，循州東山麓南流。 」從之。
The people of Lishui reported, "The county has the Tongji Canal, which channels the waters of Songyang, Suichang, and neighboring streams into it. With upper, middle, and lower sources, it runs in forty-eight branches and irrigates more than two thousand qing of farmland. Upstream communities release water for their own gain, leaving the lower reaches dry while sand chokes the canal. We ask that the dikes and dams be restored to their former state. " The ministry reviewed the proposal and approved it. Zhang Sheng, magistrate of Qidong, reported, "Xiaoqing River floods have broken through and flooded the salt fields and cropland in Qingzhou. We ask that the upper reaches be dredged and the long dike repaired so the river may follow its old channel. " The crown prince dispatched officials to take charge of the work. The people of Fuzhou reported, "The Luo River broke westward and collapsed the northeastern corner of the prefectural wall. We ask that the old course be dredged so the river may run south along the eastern foothills of the prefecture. " The request was approved.
13
十年，修浙江平陽捍潮堤岸，黃梅臨江決岸百二十餘里，海門捍潮堤百三十里。 築新會圩岸二千餘丈，獻縣、饒陽恭儉等岸，安丘紅河決岸，安州直亭等河決口八十九，華容、安津等堤決口四十六。 浚上海蟠龍江、濰縣白浪河。 北京行太僕卿楊砥言：「吳橋、東光、興濟、交河及天津等衛屯田，雨水決堤傷稼。 德州良店驛東南二十五里有黃河故道，與州南土河通。 穿渠置閘，分殺水勢，大為民便。 」命侍郎蘭芳往理之。
Yongle 10: tide embankments at Pingyang, Zhejiang, were repaired; more than 120 li of breached river bank at Huangmei; and 130 li of tide dikes at Haimen. Yongle 10: more than two thousand zhang of polder bank at Xinhui; Gongjian and other banks in Xian and Raoyang; the Hong River breach at Anqiu; eighty-nine river breaks including Zhiting at Anzhou; and forty-six dike breaks at Huarong, Anjin, and elsewhere. Panlong River in Shanghai and the Bailang River in Wei County were dredged. Yang Di, Director of the Beijing Branch of the Court of the Imperial Stud, reported, "Rain has breached dikes on garrison farms at Wuqiao, Dongguang, Xingji, Jiaohe, Tianjin, and other guards, ruining the harvest. Twenty-five li southeast of Liangdian Post in Dezhou lies an old Yellow River channel that joins the earthen river south of the prefecture. Cutting a canal and installing sluice-gates to split and tame the flood would greatly ease conditions for the people. " Vice Minister Lan Fang was ordered to take charge of the project.
14
十一年，修蕪湖陶辛、政和二圩，保定、文安二縣河口決岸五十四，應天新河圩岸，天長福勝、戚家莊二塘，滎澤大濱河堤。 浚崑山太平河。 十二年修鳳陽安豐塘水門十六座及牛角壩、新倉鋪塌岸，武陟郭村、馬曲堤岸，聊城龍灣河，濮州紅船口，範縣曹村河堤岸。 築三河決堤。 浚海州官河二百四十里。 解州民言：「臨晉涑水河逆流，決姚暹渠堰，入砂地，淹民田，將及鹽池。 」尋又言：「硝池水溢，決豁口，入鹽池。 」以涑水渠、姚暹渠並流，故命官修築如其請。
Yongle 11: the Taoxin and Zhenghe No. 2 polders at Wuhu; fifty-four river-mouth breaches in Baoding and Wen'an; the Xinghe polder bank in Yingtian; the Fusheng and Qijiazhuang ponds at Tianchang; and the Dabin River dike at Xingze. Taiping River in Kunshan was dredged. Yongle 12: sixteen sluice-gates of Anfeng Pond at Fengyang, the Niujiao Dam, and the collapsed bank at Xincangpu; dikes at Guocun and Maqu in Wuzhi; Longwan River in Liaocheng; Hongchuankou in Puzhou; and the Cao Village River embankment at Fan County. Breached dikes on the Sanhe were repaired. Two hundred forty li of the official canal in Haizhou were dredged. The people of Xiezhou reported, "At Linjin the Sushui River is running backward, has broken the Yaoqian Canal dam, spread into sandy flats, flooded farmland, and threatens the salt ponds. " Soon after they added, "Xiaochi Pond has overflowed, broken through its outlet, and poured into the salt ponds. " Because the Sushui and Yaoqian canals were running together, officials were ordered to carry out repairs as petitioned.
15
十三年，修興濟決岸、南京羽林右衛刁家圩屯田堤。 吳江縣丞李升言：「蘇、鬆水患，太湖為甚，急宜泄其下流。 若常熟白茆諸港，崑山千墩等河，長洲十八都港汊，吳縣、無錫近湖河道，皆宜循其故跡，浚而深之。 乃修蔡涇等閘，候潮來往，以時啟閉。 則氾濫可免，而民獲耕種之利。 」從之。 十五年修固安孫家口及臨漳固塚堤岸。 十六年，修魏縣決岸。
Yongle 13: the breach at Xingji and the Dijia polder garrison-farm dike of the Right Wing of the Yulin Guard in Nanjing. Li Sheng, assistant magistrate of Wujiang, reported, "Suzhou and Songjiang are plagued by flooding, worst of all from Lake Tai; its lower outlet must be opened at once. Ports such as Baimao at Changshu, rivers such as Qiandun at Kunshan, the channel mouths of the Eighteen Districts at Changzhou, and the lake-side waterways of Wu and Wuxi should all be cleared along their former courses and dug deeper. Sluices such as Caijing should also be restored, timed to the tide so they may open and close as needed. Thus flooding may be checked and the people regain land for planting. " The request was approved. Yongle 15: the Sunjiakou river mouths in Gu'an and the Guzhong bank at Linzhang. Yongle 16: the breach at Wei County was repaired.
16
十七年，蕭山民言：「境內河渠四十五里，溉田萬頃，比年淤塞。 乞疏浚，仍置閘錢清小江壩東，庶旱潦無憂。 」山東新城民言：「縣東鄭黃溝源出淄川，下流壅沮，霖潦妨農。 陳家莊南有乾河，上與溝接，下通烏江，乞浚治。 」並從之。 十八年，海甯諸縣民言：「潮沒海塘二千六百餘丈，延及吳家等壩。 」通政嶽福亦言：「仁和、海寧壞長降等壩，淪海千五百餘丈。 東岸赭山、嚴門山、蜀山舊有海道，淤絕久，故西岸潮愈猛。 乞以軍民修築。 」並從之。 明年修海寧等縣塘岸。
Yongle 17: the people of Xiaoshan reported, "The prefecture has forty-five li of canals and channels irrigating ten thousand qing of fields, but in recent years they have silted up. We ask that they be dredged and a sluice set east of the Qianqing Xiaojiang dam so drought and flood may no longer threaten us. " The people of Xincheng, Shandong, reported, "Zhenghuang Ditch east of the county rises in Zichuan; its lower course is choked, and heavy rains now ruin the crops. South of Chenjiazhuang a dry channel links the ditch above to the Wujiang below; we ask that it be dredged and restored. " Both petitions were approved. Yongle 18: the people of the Haining counties reported, "Tides have overrun more than 2,600 zhang of seawall and reached dams such as Wujia. " Director of the Office of Transmission Yue Fu also reported, "Dams such as Changjiang at Renhe and Haining have failed, and more than 1,500 zhang of coast have been swallowed by the sea. East of Zheshan, Yanmen Mountain, and Shushan there were once sea channels, now long filled in, so the western shore faces ever fiercer tides. We ask that troops and civilians be mobilized for repairs. " Both requests were approved. The following year seawall banks at Haining and other counties were repaired.
17
二十一年，修嘉定抵松江潮圮圩岸五千餘丈、交恥順化衛決堤百餘丈。 文水民言：「文谷山常稔渠分引文穀河流，袤三十餘里，灌田。 今河潰泄水。 」從其奏，葺治之。 二十二年，修臨海廣濟河閘。
Yongle 21: more than 5,000 zhang of tide-broken polder banks from Jiading to Songjiang, and more than 100 zhang of dike breach at Shunhua Guard in Jiaozhi. The people of Wenshui reported, "The Changren Canal on Wengu Mountain draws off the Wengu River for more than thirty li to irrigate fields. The river has now breached and the water is draining away. " Their petition was approved and repairs were undertaken. Yongle 22: the sluice on the Guangji River at Linhai was repaired.
18
洪熙元年修黃巖濱海閘壩。 視永樂初，增府判一員，專其事。 修獻縣、鐃陽恭儉堤及窯堤口。
Hongxi 1: the coastal sluice-dams at Huangyan were repaired. Compared with early Yongle, one additional prefectural judge was appointed to oversee the work exclusively. The Gongjian dike and Yaodi mouth in Xian and Raoyang were repaired.
19
宣德二年，浙江歸安知縣華嵩言：「涇陽洪渠堰溉五縣田八千四百餘頃。 洪武時，長興侯耿炳文前後修浚，未久堰壞。 永樂間，老人徐齡言於朝，遣官修築，會營造不果。 乞專命大臣起軍夫協治。 」從之。 三年修灌縣都江等堰四十四。 臨海民言：「胡巉諸閘瀦水灌田，近年閘壞而金鰲、大浦、湖淶、舉嶼等河遂皆壅阻，乞為開築。 」帝曰：「水利急務，使民自訴於朝，此守令不得人爾。 」命工部即飭郡縣秋收起工。 仍詔天下：「凡水利當興者，有司即舉行，毋緩視。」
Xuande 2: Hua Song, magistrate of Gui'an in Zhejiang, reported, "The Hongqu Canal dam at Jingyang waters more than 8,400 qing of fields across five counties. Under Hongwu the Changxing Marquis Geng Bingwen dredged and repaired it repeatedly, yet the dam soon failed again. In Yongle the elder Xu Ling appealed to the court and officials were dispatched to rebuild, but palace construction left the work unfinished. We ask that a senior minister be charged to mobilize laborers for a coordinated effort. " The request was approved. Xuande 3: forty-four weirs including the Dujiangyan works at Guan County were repaired. The people of Linhai reported, "The Huyan and other sluices store water for irrigation; lately the sluices have failed, and the Jin'ao, Dapu, Hulu, and Juyu rivers are all choked—we ask that they be cleared and rebuilt. " The emperor said, "Water works are urgent; when commoners must appeal to the throne themselves, the prefects and magistrates are plainly unfit for their posts. " The Ministry of Works was ordered immediately to command the prefectures and counties to start work after the autumn harvest. An edict also went out to the realm: "Wherever water works should be undertaken, local offices must act at once and must not delay."
20
巡按江西御史許勝言：「南昌瑞河兩岸低窪，多良田。 洪武間修築，水不為患。 比年水溢，岸圮二十餘處。 豐城安沙繩灣圩岸三千六百餘丈，永樂間水沖，改修百三十餘丈。 近者久雨，江漲堤壞。 乞敕有司募夫修理。 」中書舍人陸伯倫言：「常熟七浦塘東西百里，灌常熟、崑山田，歲租二十餘萬石。 乞聽民自浚之。 」皆詔可。
Xu Sheng, touring censor of Jiangxi, reported, "Both banks of the Rui River at Nanchang are low and hold rich farmland. Under Hongwu they were fortified, and the river did not threaten disaster. Lately the river has risen and more than twenty stretches of bank have given way. The Ansha Shengwan polder at Fengcheng runs more than 3,600 zhang; in Yongle floods tore it apart and only some 130 zhang were rebuilt. After prolonged rain the river has again risen and the dike has failed. We ask that officials be ordered to hire labor for repairs. " Secretariat Drafter Lu Bolun reported, "Qipu Pond stretches east and west for a hundred li, watering fields in Changshu and Kunshan that yield more than 200,000 shi in annual tax grain. We ask that the people be permitted to dredge it on their own. " All petitions received imperial approval.
21
四年，修獻縣柳林口堤岸。 潛江民言：「蚌湖、陽湖皆臨襄河，水漲岸決，害荊州三衛、荊門、江陵諸州縣官民屯田無算。 乞發軍民築治。 從之。 福清民言：「光賢裏官民田百餘頃，堤障海水。 堤壞久，田盡荒。 永樂中，嘗命修治，迄今未舉，民不得耕。 」帝責有司亟治，而諭尚書吳中嚴飭郡邑，陂池堤堰及時修浚，慢者治以罪。
Xuande 4: the dike bank at Liulin Mouth in Xian County. The people of Qianjiang reported, "Banghu and Yanghu lie on the Xiang River; rising water breaks the banks and ruins garrison farms of the three Jingzhou guards and countless official and private fields in Jingmen, Jiangling, and neighboring counties. We ask that troops and civilians be mobilized for construction and repair. The request was approved. The people of Fuqing reported, "More than a hundred qing of official and private fields in Guangxian Li rely on a seawall. The dike has long failed and the land lies wholly fallow. In Yongle repairs were ordered, yet nothing has been done since and the people cannot cultivate. " The emperor rebuked the officials to repair it at once and told Minister Wu Zhong to warn prefectures and counties that ponds, pools, dikes, and dams must be maintained promptly, with negligence punished.
22
五年，巡撫侍郎成均言：「海鹽去海二里，石嵌土岸二千四百餘丈，水齧其石，皆已刓敝。 議築新石於岸內，而存其舊者以為外障。 乞如洪武中令嘉、嚴、紹三府協夫舉工。 」從之。
Xuande 5: Grand Coordinator Cheng Jun reported, "The salt fields stand two li from the sea; more than 2,400 zhang of stone-faced earthen bank have been undercut until the stonework is ruined. The plan is to set new stonework inside the bank while leaving the old facing as an outer shield. We ask that, as in Hongwu, Jiaxing, Yanzhou, and Shaoxing be ordered to furnish labor together. " The request was approved.
23
六年，修瀏陽、廣濟諸縣堤堰，豐城西北臨江石堤及西南七圩壩，石首臨江三堤。 浚餘姚舊河池。 巡撫侍郎周忱言：「溧水永豐圩周圍八十餘里，環以丹陽、石臼諸湖。 舊築埂壩，通陟門石塔，農甚利之。 今頹敗，請葺治。 」教諭唐敏言：「常熟耿涇塘，南接梅裏，通昆承湖，北達大江。 洪武中，浚以溉田。 今壅阻，請疏導。 」並從之。
Xuande 6: dikes and dams in Liuyang, Guangji, and other counties; the northwestern riverside stone dike and seven southwestern polder dams at Fengcheng; and three river dikes at Shishou. The old river pool in Yuyao was dredged. Grand Coordinator Zhou Chen reported, "The Yongfeng polder in Lishui, over eighty li around, is encircled by Danyang, Shijiu, and other lakes. Embankments once linked it through the Shengmen Stone Pagoda and made farming highly productive. They have now fallen in; we ask that they be restored. " Instructor Tang Min reported, "Gengjing Pond at Changshu runs south to Meili and Lake Kun-Cheng and north to the Yangtze. Under Hongwu it was dredged to water fields. It is now choked; we ask that it be cleared and reopened. " Both petitions were approved.
24
七年，修眉州新津通濟堰。 堰水出彭山，分十六渠，溉田二萬五千餘畝。 河東鹽運使言：「鹽池近地姚暹河，流入五星湖轉黃流河，兩岸窪下。 比歲雨溢水漲，沖至解州。 浪益急，遂潰南岸，沒民田三十餘里，鹽池護堤皆壞。 復因下流涑水河高，壅淤逆流，姚暹以決。 乞起民夫疏瀹。 」從之。 蘇州知府況鐘言：「蘇、鬆、嘉、湖湖有六，曰太湖、龐山、陽城、沙湖、昆承、尚湖。 永樂初，夏原吉浚導，今復淤。 乞遣大臣疏浚。 」乃命周忱與鐘治之。 是歲，汾河驟溢，敗太原堤。 鎮守都司李謙、巡按御史徐傑以便宜修治，然後馳奏。 帝嘉獎之。
Xuande 7: the Tongji Weir at Xinjin in Meizhou. Its waters rise from Peng Mountain, split into sixteen canals, and irrigate more than 25,000 mu. The eastern salt transport commissioner reported, "Near the salt ponds the Yaoqian River runs into Five-Star Lake and then the Huangliu River, with low ground on both banks. Lately heavy rains have swollen the waters as far as Xiezhou. Surging floods then broke the south bank, drowned more than thirty li of farmland, and ruined every protective dike around the salt ponds. Because the lower Sushui River stands higher, silt has backed up and reversed the current, breaking Yaoqian anew. We ask that laborers be mobilized for dredging and repair. " The request was approved. Suzhou Prefect Kuang Zhong reported, "In Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou there are six lakes—Taihu, Pangshan, Yangcheng, Shahu, Kun-Cheng, and Shanghu. Early in the Yongle reign Xia Yuanji dredged and opened them; they have silted up again. We ask that a senior minister be dispatched to dredge them. " The court then ordered Zhou Chen and Kuang Zhong to take charge of the project. That year the Fen River burst its banks and destroyed the Taiyuan dikes. Regional Commander Li Qian and Investigating Censor Xu Jie repaired the damage on their own authority and then submitted an urgent memorial. The emperor commended them.
25
八年，葺湖廣偏橋衛高陂石洞，完縣南關舊河。 復和州銅城堰閘。 修安陽廣惠等渠，磁州滏陽河、五爪濟民渠。 九年修江陵枝江沿江堤岸。 築薊州決岸。 毀蘇、鬆民私築堤堰。 十年築海鹽潮決海塘千五百餘丈。 主事沈中言：「山陰西小江，上通金、嚴，下接三江海口，引諸暨、浦江、義烏諸湖水以通舟。 江口近淤，宜築臨浦戚堰障諸湖水，俾仍出小江。 」詔部覆奪。
Xuande 8: the Gaopo stone culvert at Pianqiao Guard in Huguang was restored and the old river at the county south pass was completed. The Tongcheng Weir sluice at Hezhou was restored. The Guanghui and other canals at Anyang were repaired, along with the Fuyang River and the Wuzhua People's Canal at Cizhou. Xuande 9: the riverside dikes at Zhijiang in Jiangling. Burst banks at Jizhou were repaired. Illegal private dikes and weirs in Suzhou and Songjiang were torn down. Xuande 10: more than 1,500 zhang of seawall were built where tidal breaches had opened at Haiyan. Director Shen Zhong reported, "The West Xiaojiang in Shanyin links upstream to Jinhua and Yanzhou and downstream to the Sanjiang estuary, channeling the waters of Zhuji, Pujiang, Yiwu, and other lakes for navigation. The mouth has recently silted up; a Linpu Qi Weir should be built to hold back the lake waters while still releasing them through the Xiaojiang. " The Ministry was ordered to investigate and rule on the proposal.
26
正統元年，修吉安沿江堤。 築海陽、登雲、都雲、步村等決堤。 浚陝西西安灞橋河。 二年築蠡縣王家等決口。 修新會鸞臺山至瓦塘浦頹岸，江陵、鬆滋、公安、石首、潛江、監利近江決堤。 又修湖廣老龍堤，以為漢水所潰也。 三年疏泰興順德鄉三渠，引湖溉田； 潞州永祿等溝渠二十八道，通於漳河。 四年修容城杜村口堤。 設正陽門外減水河，並疏城內溝渠。 荊州民言：「城西江水高城十餘丈，霖潦壞堤，水即灌城。 請先事修治。 」寧夏巡撫都御史金濂言：「鎮有五渠，資以行溉，今明沙州七星、漢伯、石灰三渠久塞。 請用夫四萬疏浚，溉蕪田千三百餘頃。 」並從之。
Zhengtong 1: the riverside dike at Ji'an. Breached dikes at Haiyang, Dengyun, Duyun, Bucun, and elsewhere were repaired. The Baqiao River at Xi'an in Shaanxi was dredged. Zhengtong 2: breach openings at Wangjia and elsewhere in Li County were closed. Collapsed banks from Luan Terrace Mountain to Watang Ford in Xinhui were restored, along with riverine breach dikes at Jiangling, Songzi, Gong'an, Shishou, Qianjiang, and Jianli. The Laolong Dike in Huguang was also restored, having been breached by the Han River. Zhengtong 3: three canals in Shunde Township, Taixing, were opened to channel lake water for irrigation; and twenty-eight ditches including Yonglu at Luzhou were cleared to join the Zhang River. Zhengtong 4: the dike at Dukou Village, Rongcheng. A flood-relief canal was opened outside Zhengyang Gate and the city's inner canals were dredged. The people of Jingzhou reported, "West of the city the river stands more than ten zhang above the walls; when torrential rains break the dikes, water pours straight into the city. We ask that repairs be carried out in advance. " Ningxia Grand Coordinator Jin Lian reported, "The garrison relies on five irrigation canals; at Ming Sha Prefecture the Qixing, Hanbo, and Shihui canals have long been choked shut. We ask to mobilize forty thousand laborers for dredging to water more than 1,300 qing of fallow fields. " All petitions were approved.
27
五年，修太湖堤，海鹽海岸，南京上中下新河及濟川衛新江口防水堤，漷縣、南宮諸堤。 築順天、河間及容城杜村口、郎家口決堤。 塞海寧蠣巖決堤口。 浚鹽城伍祐、新興二場運河。 初，溧水有鎮曰廣通，其西固城湖入大江，東則三塔堰河入太湖。 中間相距十五里，洪武中鑿以通舟。 縣地稍ＡＨ，而湖納甯國、廣德諸水，遇潦即溢，乃築壩於鎮以禦之，而堰水不能至壩下。 是歲，改築壩於葉家橋。 胭脂河者，溧水入秦淮道也。 蘇、鬆船皆由以達，沙石壅塞，因並浚之。 山陽涇河壩，上接漕河，下達鹽城，舊置絞關以通舟，歲久且敝，又恐盜泄水利，遂築塞河口。 是歲，從民請，修壩並復絞關。
Zhengtong 5: Taihu dikes, the Haiyan coast, Nanjing's upper, middle, and lower new rivers and the flood dikes at Jichuan Guard's new river mouth, and dikes at Huo County, Nangong, and elsewhere. Breached dikes at Shuntian, Hejian, and at Dukou Village and Langjiakou in Rongcheng were repaired. The breach at the Oyster Rock dike in Haining was sealed. The transport canal at the Wuyou and Xinxing salt yards in Yancheng was dredged. Earlier, Lishui had a market town called Guangtong: to the west Gucheng Lake joins the Yangtze, and to the east the Santa Weir River flows into Taihu. Fifteen li lay between them; under Hongwu a channel was cut for shipping. The county lies somewhat low, and the lake takes in the waters of Ningguo, Guangde, and other districts; in flood season it spills over, so a dam was built at the town to hold it back, yet the weir water could not reach below the dam. That year the dam was relocated and rebuilt at Ye Family Bridge. The Yanzhi River is Lishui's channel into the Qinhuai. Suzhou and Songjiang shipping all passed through it, but sand and gravel had choked it, so it was dredged along with the other works. At Shanyang the Jinghe Weir Dam links the Grand Canal upstream to Yancheng downstream; winch sluices once allowed passage, but after years of decay—and fear that thieves might drain the works—the mouth was dammed shut. That year, at popular request, the weir was repaired and the winch sluices reopened.
28
六年，造宣武門東城河南岸橋。 修江米巷玉河橋及堤，並浚京城西南河。 築豐城沙月諸河堤、蕪湖陶辛圩新埂。 浚海寧官河及花塘河、硤石橋塘河，築瓦石堰二所。 疏南京江洲，殺其水勢，以便修築塌岸。 高郵知州韓簡言：「官河上下二閘皆圮，河亦不通，且子嬰溝塞，減水陰洞閉，致旱澇無所濟。 俱乞浚治。 」詔部核實以行。
Zhengtong 6: a bridge was built on the south bank of the eastern moat outside Xuanwu Gate. The Jade River Bridge in Jiangmi Lane and its embankment were restored, and the southwestern canal within the capital was dredged. Dikes on the Shayue and other rivers at Fengcheng were raised, and a new embankment was built for the Taoxin Polder at Wuhu. Haining's official river, Huatang River, and Qiaoshi Bridge Pond River were dredged, and two tile-and-stone weirs were constructed. Nanjing's Jiangzhou sandbars were dredged to ease the current and allow repair of collapsed riverbanks. Gaoyou Prefect Han Jian reported, "Both upper and lower sluices on the official river have collapsed and the channel is impassable; Ziying Ditch is silted shut and the flood-relief culvert is closed, leaving drought and flood alike without remedy. We ask that all be dredged and restored. " The Ministry was ordered to verify the facts and proceed.
29
七年，修江西廣昌江岸、蕭山長山浦海塘、彭山通濟堰。 築南京浦子口、大勝關堤，九江及武昌臨江塌岸。 浚江陵、荊門、潛江淤沙三十餘里。 八年修蘭溪卸橋浦口堤，弋陽官陂三所。 浚南京城河。
Zhengtong 7: the riverbank at Guangchang in Jiangxi, the seadike at Changshan Ford in Xiaoshan, and the Tongji Weir at Pengshan. Dikes at Puzikou and Dasheng Pass in Nanjing were raised, and collapsed riverbanks at Jiujiang and Wuchang were repaired. More than thirty li of silted channel at Jiangling, Jingmen, and Qianjiang were cleared. Zhengtong 8: the ford dike at Xieqiao in Lanxi and three official weirs at Yiyang. Nanjing's city moat was dredged.
30
九年，修德州耿家灣等堤岸、杞縣離溝堤。 築容城杜村堤決口。 易上虞菱湖土壩為石閘。 挑無錫裏谷、蘇塘、華港、上村、李走馬塘諸河，東南接蘇州苑山湖塘，北通揚子江，西接新興河，引水灌田。 浚杞縣牛墓岡舊河，武進太平、永興二河。 疏海鹽永安省，茶市院新涇、陶涇塘諸河。 都御史陳鎰言：「朝邑多沙鹻，難耕。 縣治洛河，與渭水通，請穿渠灌之。 」新安民言：「城南長溝河，西通徐、漕二水，東連雄縣直沽，沙土淤塞，請發丁夫疏浚。 」海陽民蕭瑤言：「縣有長溪，源出山麓，流抵海口，周袤潮郡，故登隆等都俱置溝通溉。 惟隆津等都陸野絕水，歲旱無所賴。 乞開溝如登隆。 」長樂民劉彥樑言：「嚴湖二十餘里，南接稠菴溪，西通倒流溪，可備旱溢。 又有張塘涵、塘前涵、大塘涵、陳塘港，其利如嚴湖。 乞令有司疏浚。 」廣濟民言：「縣與鄰邑黃梅，歲運糧三萬石於望牛墩。 小車盤剝，不堪其勞。 連城湖港廖家口有溝抵墩前，淤淺不能行船。 請與黃梅合力浚通，以便水運。 」並從之。
Zhengtong 9: dike banks at Geng Family Bay and elsewhere in Dezhou and the Ligou dike in Qi County. The breach in the dike at Dukou Village, Rongcheng, was closed. Shangyu's earthen Linghu Dam was replaced with a stone sluice gate. Ligutang, Sutang, Huagang, Shangcun, Lizoumatang, and other canals in Wuxi were excavated—linking southeast to Suzhou's Garden Mountain lake embankment, north to the Yangtze, and west to the Xinxing River—to channel water for irrigation. The old channel at Niumugang in Qi County and the Taiping and Yongxing rivers in Wujin were dredged. The Yong'an Quarter in Haiyan and the Xinjing, Taojing Pond, and other rivers at Chashiyuan were cleared. Grand Coordinator Chen Yong reported, "Chaoyi is largely saline sand and hard to cultivate. The county seat lies on the Luo River, which joins the Wei; we ask that a canal be cut to irrigate the land. " The people of Xin'an reported, "South of the city the Changgou River westward joins the Xu and Grand Canal waters and eastward links Xiong County and the Straight Estuary; sand and silt have choked it—we ask that corvée labor be sent to dredge it. " Xiao Yao of Haiyang reported, "The county has a long stream rising in the foothills and reaching the sea, encircling Chaozhou; Denglong and other districts therefore all have irrigation ditches. Only Longjin and other inland districts lack water entirely and have nothing to fall back on in drought years. We ask that ditches be opened as in Denglong. " Liu Yanliang of Changle reported, "Yan Lake stretches more than twenty li, south to Chou'an Stream and west to Daoliu Stream, and can buffer both drought and flood. Zhangtang Han, Tangqian Han, Datang Han, and Chentang Port offer the same benefits as Yan Lake. We ask that the local authorities be ordered to dredge them. " The people of Guangji reported, "Our county and neighboring Huangmei each year transport thirty thousand shi of grain to Wangniudun. Grain is transferred by small carts in endless relays—the burden is unbearable. At Liaojiakou in Liancheng Lake Harbor a ditch runs to the landing, but it is silted too shallow for boats. We ask to join Huangmei in dredging it open for water transport. " All petitions were approved.
31
十一年，修洞庭湖堤。 築登州河岸。 浚通州金沙場八里河，以通運渠。 任丘民言：「淩城港去縣二十五里，內有定安橋河，北十八里通流，東七里沙塞。 宜疏通與港相接。 入直沽張家灣。 」巡撫周忱言：「應天、鎮江、太平、甯國諸府，舊有石臼等湖。 其中溝港，歲辦魚課。 其外平圩淺灘，聽民牧放孳畜、採掘菱藕，不許種耕。 故山溪水漲，有所宣洩。 近者富豪築圩田，遏湖水，每遇泛溢，害即及民，宜悉禁革。 」並從之。
Zhengtong 11: Dongting Lake dikes. The riverbank at Dengzhou was reinforced. The Bali River at Jinsha Yard in Tongzhou was dredged to link with the transport canal. The people of Renqiu reported, "Lingcheng Harbor lies twenty-five li from the county; within it is Ding'an Bridge River—eighteen li to the north it still flows, but seven li to the east are sand-choked. It should be dredged open and linked to the harbor. It enters the Straight Estuary at Zhangjiawan. " Grand Coordinator Zhou Chen reported, "Yingtian, Zhenjiang, Taiping, Ningguo, and other prefectures once had lakes such as Shijiu. Their inner channels and harbors yield annual fish taxes. Outside lie level polders and shallow flats where the people may pasture livestock and gather lotus and water chestnuts—farming is forbidden. Thus when mountain streams rise, the water has somewhere to spread. Lately the wealthy have walled off polder fields and dammed the lakes; whenever waters flood, the harm falls on the people—all such encroachments should be wholly banned. " All proposals were approved.
32
十二年，疏平度州大灣口河道，荊州公安門外河，以便公安、石首諸縣輸納。 浙江聽選官王信言：「紹興東小江，南通諸暨七十二湖，西通錢塘江。 近為潮水湧塞，江與田平，舟不能行，久雨水溢，鄰田輒受其害。 乞發丁夫疏浚。 」從之。
Zhengtong 12: the Dawankou channel at Pingdu and the river outside Gong'an Gate in Jingzhou were cleared to ease grain transport from Gong'an, Shishou, and neighboring counties. Wang Xin, a candidate official in Zhejiang, reported, "Shaoxing's East Xiaojiang runs south to Zhuji's seventy-two lakes and west to the Qiantang River. Lately tidal silting has raised the channel level with the fields; boats cannot pass, and after prolonged rains the waters spill over and neighboring fields suffer. We ask that corvée labor be dispatched for dredging. " The request was approved.
33
十三年，築寧夏漢、唐壩決口。 疏山西涑水河、南海縣通海泉源。 鑿宣府城濠，引城北山水入南城大河。 湖廣五開衛言：「衛與苗接，山路峻險。 去衛三十里有水通靖州江，亂石沙灘，請疏以便輸運。 」雲南鄧川州言：「本州民田與大理衛屯田接壤湖畔，每歲雨水沙土壅淤，禾苗淹沒。 乞命州衛軍民疏治。 」並從之。
Zhengtong 13: breach openings at the Han and Tang Weirs in Ningxia were closed. The Sushui River in Shanxi and Nanhai County's sea outlet spring were cleared. Xuanfu's city moat was excavated and mountain water north of the city was channeled into the great river through the southern city. Wukai Guard in Huguang reported, "The guard adjoins Miao territory and the mountain roads are treacherous. Thirty li from the guard a waterway links to the Jingzhou River, but jumbled rock and sand bars block it—we ask that it be dredged to ease transport." Dengchuan Prefecture in Yunnan reported, "Our civilian fields adjoin Dali Guard's garrison farmland along the lake, and each year rain washes sand and silt that choke the shore and drown the crops. We ask that troops and civilians of the prefecture and guard be commanded to dredge the channel. " Both petitions were approved.
34
十四年，浚南海潘埇堤岸，置水閘。 和州民言：「州有姥鎮河，上通麻、澧二湖，下接牛屯大河，長七十里許，廣八丈。 又有張家溝，連銅城閘，通大江，長減姥鎮之半，廣如之，灌溉降福等七十餘圩及南京諸衛屯田，近年河潰閘圮，率皆淤塞。 請興役疏浚，仍於姥鎮、豐山嘴、葉公坡各建閘以備旱澇。 」從之。
In the fourteenth year the Pan Yong dikes at Nanhai were dredged and sluice gates were installed. The people of He Prefecture reported, "The prefecture has the Laozhen River, which upstream links the Ma and Li lakes and downstream meets the Niutun main stream—about seventy li long and eight zhang wide. There is also Zhangjia Ditch, which connects to Tongcheng Sluice and reaches the Yangtze; it is half as long as Laozhen and equally wide, watering more than seventy polders including Jiangfu and the Nanjing garrison farmlands. In recent years the river has breached, the gates have fallen in, and everything is choked with silt. We ask that labor be mobilized to dredge the channels and that sluices be built at Laozhen, Fengshan Mouth, and Yegong Slope to control drought and flood. " The request was approved.
35
景泰元年，築丹陽甘露等壩。 二年修玉河東、西堤。 浚安定門東城河，永嘉三十六都河，常熟顧新塘，南至當湖，北至揚子江。 三年修泰和信豐堤。 築延安、綏德決河，綿州西岔河通江堤岸。 浚常熟七浦塘，劍州海子。 疏孟瀆河浜涇十一。 工部言：「海鹽石塘十八里，潮水沖決，浮土修築，不能久。 」詔別築石塘捍之。
In Jingtai 1 the Ganlu and other dams at Danyang were constructed. In the second year the eastern and western embankments of the Jade River were repaired. Work dredged the moat east of Anding Gate, the Thirty-six Wards River in Yongjia, and Gu Xin's pond at Changshu—from Dang Lake in the south to the Yangtze in the north. In the third year the Taihe and Xinfeng dikes were repaired. Breached Yellow River banks at Yan'an and Suide were repaired, along with the embankment where Xicha River at Mianzhou joins the main stream. Qipu Pond at Changshu and Haizi at Jian Prefecture were dredged. Eleven branch channels of the Mengdu River and Bangjing were cleared. The Ministry of Works reported, "An eighteen-li stone seawall for the coastal salt works has been breached by tide; repairs in loose earth will not endure. " The throne ordered a new stone seawall built to hold the tide.
36
四年，浚江陰順塘河十餘里，東接永利倉大河，西通夏港及揚子江。 雲南總兵官沐璘言：「城東有水南流，源發邵甸，會九十九泉為一，抵松花壩分為二支：一繞金馬山麓，入滇池； 一從黑窯村流至雲澤橋，亦入滇池。 舊於下流築堰，溉軍民田數十萬頃，霖潦無所泄。 請令受利之家，自造石閘，啟閉以時。 」報可。 五年疏靈寶黎園莊渠，通鴻瀘澗，溉田萬頃。 六年浚華容杜預渠，通運船入江，避洞庭險。 修容城白溝河杜村口、固安楊家等口決堤。
In the fourth year more than ten li of Shuntang River at Jiangyin were dredged, linking east to the Yongli granary channel and west to Xi Harbor and the Yangtze. Mu Lin, regional commander of Yunnan, reported, "East of the city a stream runs south from Shaodian, where ninety-nine springs combine; at Songhua Dam it splits into two branches—one bending along Jinma Mountain into Dian Lake; one flowing from Heiyao Village to Yunze Bridge, likewise entering Dian Lake. A dam on the lower reach once irrigated hundreds of thousands of qing of military and civilian land, but in heavy rains the water had no outlet. We ask that benefiting households be ordered to build stone gates and operate them on schedule. " The petition was approved. In the fifth year the Liyuanzhuang canal at Lingbao was dredged through to Honglu Gorge, watering ten thousand qing of fields. In the sixth year Du Yu's canal at Huarong was dredged so grain boats could reach the river and avoid Dongting's hazards. Breached dikes at Dukou on the Baigou at Rongcheng and at Yangjia and other breaks at Gu'an were repaired.
37
七年，尚書孫原貞言：「杭州西湖舊有二閘，近皆傾圮，湖遂淤塞。 按宋蘇軾雲『杭本江海故地，水泉堿苦。 自唐李泌引湖水入城為六井，然後井邑日富，不可許人佃種。 』周淙亦言：『西湖貴深闊。 』因招兵二百，專一撈湖。 其後，豪戶復請佃，湖日益填塞，大旱水涸。 詔郡守趙與亹開浚，芰荷茭蕩悉去，杭民以利。 此前代經理西湖大略也。 其後，勢豪侵佔無已，湖小淺狹，閘石毀壞。 今民田無灌溉資，官河亦澀阻。 乞敕有司興浚，禁侵佔以利軍民。 」從之。
In the seventh year Minister Sun Yuanzhen reported, "Hangzhou's West Lake once had two gates, but both have lately collapsed and the lake has silted shut. Su Shi of the Song wrote that Hangzhou was once seabed and its springs brackish and bitter. In Tang, Li Bi brought lake water into the city for six wells; the town flourished—and the lake must not be leased for cultivation. Zhou Cong also wrote, "The lake must be kept deep and broad." He then recruited two hundred men devoted solely to dredging the lake. Later powerful families again secured leases, the lake silted ever faster, and in severe drought it ran dry. The court ordered Prefect Zhao Yuwen to dredge it, clearing lotus and reeds so Hangzhou profited. Such was the earlier dynasties' general approach to managing West Lake. Afterward powerful encroachers never ceased—the lake shrank and shallowed and the gate stones fell apart. Today civilian fields lack irrigation and the official channels are choked. We ask that officials be ordered to dredge the lake, forbid encroachments, and restore water for troops and civilians alike. " The request was approved.
38
天順二年，修彭縣萬工堰，灌田千餘頃。 五年，僉事李觀言：「涇水出涇陽仲山谷，道高陵，至櫟陽入渭，袤二百里。 漢開渠溉田，宋、元俱設官主之。 今雖有瓠口鄭、白二渠，而堤堰摧決，溝洫壅瀦，民弗蒙利。 」乃命有司浚之。
In Tianshun 2 the Wangong Weir at Peng County was repaired, watering more than a thousand qing. In the fifth year Commissioner Li Guan reported, "The Jing rises in Zhong Valley, Jingyang, runs past Gaoling, and joins the Wei at Liyang—a course of two hundred li. Han times opened canals for irrigation; Song and Yuan each appointed officials to oversee them. Today the Zheng and Bai canals at Hulu Kou remain, but dikes are breached, channels choked, and the people gain nothing. " The throne ordered the relevant offices to dredge the canals.
39
八年，永平民言：「漆河繞城西南流入海，城趾皆石，故水不能決。 其餘則沙土易潰，前人於東北築土堤，西南甓岸。 今歲久日塌，宜作堤於東流，橫以激之，使合西流，庶無蕩析患。 」都御史項忠言：「涇陽之瓠口鄭、白二渠，引涇水溉田數萬頃，至元猶溉八千頃。 其後渠日淺，利因以廢。 宣德初，遣官修鑿，畝收四三石。 無何復塞，渠旁之田，遇旱為赤地。 涇陽、醴泉、三原、高陵皆患苦之。 昨請於涇水上源龍潭左側疏浚，訖舊渠口，尋以詔例停止。 今宜畢其役。 西安城西井泉堿苦，飲者輒病。 龍首渠引水七十里，修築不易，且利止及城東。 西南皁河去城一舍許，可鑿，令引水與龍首渠會，則居民盡利。 」邳州知州孟琳言：「榆行諸社俱臨沂河，久雨岸崩二十八處，低田盡淹。 乞與修築。 並從之。
In the eighth year the people of Yongping reported, "The Qi River skirts the southwest of the city to the sea; the walls sit on bedrock, so the current cannot undercut them. Elsewhere sandy banks fail easily; predecessors built earthen dikes to the northeast and brick revetments to the southwest. Long neglect has brought collapse—we should build a dike on the eastward course and deflect the flow westward to prevent scour and breach. Censor-in-chief Xiang Zhong reported, "The Zheng and Bai canals at Hulu Kou, Jingyang, once watered tens of thousands of qing; under Yuan they still irrigated eight thousand. Later the channels silted daily until the works fell idle. Early in Xuande officials were sent to dredge them and harvests reached three or four shi per mu. Soon they choked again, and fields along the canals turned bare red clay in drought. Jingyang, Liquan, Sanyuan, and Gaoling all suffered for it. A petition recently asked to dredge left of Longtan at the Jing's head down to the old mouth, but work halted under an edict restricting labor. The work should now be finished. West of Xi'an the wells are brackish and bitter, and drinkers fall ill. The Longshou Canal brings water seventy li—costly to build and repair, and it only waters the east of the city. The Zao River lies a she to the southwest and could be cut open to meet the Longshou Canal, watering all residents. Prefect Meng Lin of Pi reported, "Communities along the Yi have suffered twenty-eight bank collapses in the long rains and low fields are flooded. We ask for repairs. All petitions were approved.
40
成化二年，修壽州安豐塘。 四年，疏石州城河。 六年，修平湖周家涇及獨山海塘。 七年，潮決錢塘江岸及山陰、會稽、蕭山、上虞，乍浦、瀝海二所，錢清諸場。 命侍郎李顒修築。 八年，堤襄陽決岸。 十年，廷臣會議：江浦北城圩古溝，北通滁河浦子口； 城東黑水泉古溝，南入大江。 二溝相望，岡壟中截。 宜鑿通成河，旱引澇泄。 從之。
In Chenghua 2 the Anfeng Pond at Shou Prefecture was repaired. In the fourth year the moat at Shi Prefecture was dredged. In the sixth year Zhoujia Creek at Pinghu and the Dushan seawall were repaired. In the seventh year tide breached the Qiantang estuary banks and coasts of Shanyin, Kuaiji, Xiaoshan, Shangyu, the Zhapu and Lihai salt districts, and the Qianqing pans. Vice Minister Li Yong was ordered to undertake repairs. In the eighth year breached banks at Xiangyang were restored. In the tenth year ministers met: Jiangpu's north-city polder ancient ditch, north to Puzikou on the Chu River; and east of the city the Heishui Spring ancient ditch, south to the Yangtze. The two ditches face each other but a ridge between blocks them. They should be cut through into one channel, drawing water in drought and draining flood. The proposal was approved.
41
十一年，浚杭州錢塘門故渠，左屬湧金門，建橋閘以蓄湖水。 巡撫都御史牟俸言：「山東小清河，上接濟南趵突諸泉，下通樂安沿海高家港鹽場。 大清河，上接東平坎河諸泉，下通濱州海豐、利津，沿海富國鹽場。 淤塞，苦盤剝，雨水又患淹沒。 勸農參政唐虞浚河造閘，請令兼治水利。 」詔可。
In the eleventh year Hangzhou dredged the old channel at Qiantang Gate, tying it to Yongjin Gate and building bridge-gates to hold West Lake water. Grand Coordinator Mu Feng reported, "Shandong's Xiaoqing River upstream gathers Jinan's Baotu and other springs and downstream reaches the Gaojia Harbor salt works on the Le'an coast. The Daqing River upstream takes Dongping's Kan River springs and downstream serves Haifeng and Lijin in Bin Prefecture and the coastal Fuguo salt pans. Both are silt-choked, scour undercuts their banks, and rain now brings flooding. Agricultural Intendant Tang Yu has dredged the rivers and built gates—please let him also oversee water works. " The throne assented.
42
十二年，巡按御史許進言：「河西十五衛，東起莊浪，西抵肅州，綿亙幾二千里，所資水利多奪於勢豪。 宜設官專理。 」詔屯田僉事兼之。
In the twelfth year Investigating Censor Xu Jin reported, "Fifteen guards west of the river from Zhuanglang east to Suzhou west span nearly two thousand li, and much of their irrigation has been seized by powerful families. A dedicated official should be appointed. " The throne ordered the garrison-lands commissioner to take the duty concurrently.
43
十四年，俸言：「直隸蘇、鬆與浙西各府，頻年旱澇，緣周環太湖，乃東南最窪地，而蘇、鬆尤最下之沖。 故每逢積雨，眾水奔潰，湖泖漲漫，淹沒無際。 按太湖即古震澤，上納嘉、湖、宣、歙諸州之水，下通婁、東、吳淞三江之流，東江今不復見，婁、淞入海故跡具存。 其地勢與常熟福山、白茆二塘俱能導太湖入江海，使民無墊溺，而土可耕種，歷代開浚具有成法。 本朝亦常命官修治，不得其要。 而濱湖豪家盡將淤灘栽蒔為利。 治水官不悉利害，率於泄處置石樑，壅土為道，或慮盜船往來，則釘木為柵。 以致水道堙塞，公私交病。 請擇大臣深知水利者專理之，設提督水利分司一員隨時修理，則水勢疏通，東南厚利也。 」帝即令俸兼領水利，聽所浚築。 功成，乃專設分司。
In the fourteenth year Feng reported, "Suzhou, Songjiang, and the western Zhe prefectures suffer repeated drought and flood because they ring Tai Lake—the lowest land in the southeast—Suzhou and Songjiang lowest of all. Whenever rains pile up, waters pour in, lakes and marshes swell, and flooding knows no bounds. Tai Lake is the ancient Zhen Marsh, gathering waters from Jiaxing, Huzhou, Xuanzhou, and Shezhou above and discharging through the Lou, Dong, and Wusong rivers below—the Dong branch is gone today, but the old courses of Lou and Wusong to the sea still exist. Its lay, with Changshu's Fushan and Baimao dikes, can channel Tai Lake to the rivers and sea, spare the people drowning, and keep fields arable—each dynasty's dredging followed established methods. Our dynasty too has often sent officials, but without grasping the essentials. Meanwhile lakeside magnates have planted every silt flat for private gain. Water officials ignorant of the trade habitually set stone beams and earthen causeways at outfalls, or nailed wooden barriers against pirate craft. Channels choked and public and private interests alike suffered. Choose a senior minister who truly understands hydraulics, appoint a water-works sub-commissioner for ongoing repair, and the southeast will regain its great profit once the waters run free. " The emperor promptly put Feng in charge of water works as well, authorizing whatever dredging and construction he deemed fit. After the work succeeded, a dedicated sub-commission was established.
44
十五年，修南京內外河道。 十八年，浚雲南東西二溝，自鬆華壩黑龍潭抵西南柳壩南村，灌田數萬頃。 修居庸關水關、城券及隘口水門四十九，樓鋪、墩臺百二。 二十年，修嘉興等六府海田堤岸，特選京堂官往督之。 二十二年，浚南京中下二新河。
In the fifteenth year Nanjing's inner and outer canals were repaired. In the eighteenth year Yunnan's eastern and western ditches were dredged from Songhua Dam and Black Dragon Pool to Liuba Nan Village in the southwest, watering tens of thousands of qing. Juyong Pass water gates, ramparts, and forty-nine pass sluices were repaired, along with one hundred two watch buildings and beacon platforms. In the twentieth year coastal dikes in six prefectures including Jiaxing were repaired under a specially appointed capital official. In the twenty-second year Nanjing's middle and lower new canals were dredged.
45
弘治三年，從巡撫都御史丘鼐言，設官專領灌縣都江堰。 六年，敕撫民參政硃瑄浚河南伊、洛，彰德高平、萬金，懷慶廣濟，南陽召公等渠，汝寧桃陂等堰。
Hongzhi 3, acting on Grand Coordinator Qiu Qi's petition, an official was appointed solely to oversee the Dujiangyan at Guan County. In the sixth year Pacification Intendant Zhu Xuan was ordered to dredge the Yi and Luo in Henan, the Gaoping and Wanjin canals in Zhangde, the Guangji canal in Huaiqing, the Shao Gong and other canals in Nanyang, and the Taobei and other weirs in Runing.
46
七年，浚南京天、潮二河，備軍衛屯田水利。 七月命侍郎徐貫與都御史何鑒經理浙西水利。 明年四月告成。 貫初奉命，奏以主事祝萃自隨。 萃乘小舟究悉源委。 貫乃令蘇州通判張旻疏各河港水，瀦之大壩。 旋開白茆港沙面，乘潮退，決大壩水沖激之，沙泥刷盡。 潮水蕩激，日益闊深，水達海無阻。 又令浙江參政周季麟修嘉興舊堤三十餘里，易之以石，增繕湖州長興堤岸七十餘里。 貫乃上言：「東南財賦所出，而水患為多。 永樂初，命夏原吉疏浚。 時以吳淞江氵豔沙浮蕩，未克施工。 迨今九十餘年，港浦愈塞。 臣督官行視，浚吳江長橋，導太湖散入氵殿山、陽城、昆承等湖泖。 復開吳淞江並大石、趙屯等浦，泄氵殿山湖水，由吳淞江以達於海。 開白茆港白魚洪、鯰魚口，泄昆承湖水，由白茆港以注於江。 開斜堰、七鋪、鹽鐵等塘，泄陽城湖水，由七丫港以達於海。 下流疏通，不復壅塞。 乃開湖州之漊涇，泄西湖、天目、安吉諸山之水，自西南入於太湖。 開常州之百瀆，泄溧陽、鎮江、練湖之水，自西北入於太湖。 又開諸陡門，泄漕河之水，由江陰以入於大江。 上流亦通，不復堙滯。 」是役也，修浚河、港、涇、瀆、湖、塘、陡門、堤岸百三十五道，役夫二十餘萬，祝萃之功多焉。
In the seventh year Nanjing's Tian and Chao rivers were dredged for the garrison irrigation system. In the seventh month Vice Minister Xu Guan and Censor-in-chief He Jian were charged with western Zhe water works. The following April they reported completion. When Xu Guan first took up the commission, he memorialized that Principal Secretary Zhu Cui should accompany him. Zhu Cui went out in a small boat and traced every source and channel to its end. Xu Guan then had Zhang Min, vice prefect of Suzhou, draw off the waters of the river channels and pond them behind a great earthen dam. They next cut open the sand shoals at Bai Mao Harbor; as the tide fell, they broke the dam and let the stored water rush through, scouring away every grain of silt. The tide surged through the cut; day by day the channel grew wider and deeper until water ran freely to the sea. He also set Zhejiang Administration Commissioner Zhou Jilin to rebuild more than thirty li of Jiaxing's old dike in stone, and to add more than seventy li of new works on the Changxing banks in Huzhou. Xu Guan then memorialized: "The southeast is the empire's main source of revenue, yet it suffers most from flood. In early Yongle the court charged Xia Yuanji with dredging the whole system. At the time the Wusong's muddy shoals drifted so freely that the work could not proceed. Nearly a century has passed since, and every harbor and creek has silted tighter still. I supervised inspection teams, dredged the Long Bridge at Wujiang, and opened channels so Tai Lake could spread into Dianshan, Yangcheng, Kun Cheng, and the other backwaters. We reopened the Wusong together with Da Shi, Zhao Tun, and other outlets, draining the Dianshan lakes to the sea by way of the Wusong. We cut open Baiyu Flood and Nianyu Mouth on Bai Mao Harbor to send Kun Cheng waters into the Yangtze. We opened the Xieyan, Qibu, Yantie, and other canals so Yangcheng's waters could reach the sea through Qiya Harbor. The lower reaches were clear and no longer choked. We opened Louding Creek in Huzhou to bring in the waters of West Lake, Tianmu, Anji, and the western hills into Tai Lake from the southwest. We opened Changzhou's Hundred Creeks to channel Liyang, Zhenjiang, and Lian Lake waters into Tai Lake from the northwest. We also opened the steep sluices to release Grand Canal water into the Yangtze through Jiangyin. The upper reaches flowed freely as well, no longer backed up. " The campaign cleared or rebuilt one hundred thirty-five rivers, harbors, creeks, canals, lakes, embankments, sluices, and dikes, mobilizing more than two hundred thousand workers—and Zhu Cui's contribution was foremost among them.
47
巡撫都御史王珣言：「寧夏古渠三道，東漢、中唐並通。 惟西一渠傍山，長三百餘里，廣二十餘丈，兩岸危峻，漢、唐舊跡俱堙。 宜發卒浚鑿，引水下流。 即以土築東岸，建營堡屯兵以遏寇沖。 請帑銀三萬兩，並靈州六年鹽課，以給其費。 」又請於靈州金積山河，開渠灌田，給軍民佃種。 並從之。
Grand Coordinator Wang Xun reported: "Ningxia's three ancient canals all ran clear under the Eastern Han and mid-Tang. Only the western canal along the mountains survives on the books—over three hundred li long and twenty zhang wide, with sheer banks—but every Han and Tang trace has long been buried. We should put troops to digging it out and send the water down again. Earth from the cut could raise the eastern bank, and we could build camps and garrisons to block nomad raids. He asked for thirty thousand taels from the treasury plus six years of Lingzhou salt revenue to pay for it. " He also proposed opening a canal on the Jijishan River at Lingzhou to irrigate fields for soldiers and civilians to farm. Both proposals were approved.
48
十八年，修築常熟塘壩，自尚湖口抵江，及黃、泗等浦，新莊等沙三十餘處。 浚杭州西湖。
In the eighteenth year they built and dredged Changshu's dikes and dams from Shanghu Mouth to the river, along the Huang, Si, and other creeks, and at Xinzhuang and more than thirty other shoals. They dredged Hangzhou's West Lake.
49
正德七年，修廣平滏陽河口堤岸。 十四年浚南京新江口右河。 十五年，御史成英言：「應天等衛屯田在江北滁、和、六合者，地勢低，屢為水敗。 從金城港抵濁河達烏江三十餘里，因舊跡浚之，則水勢泄而屯田利。 」詔可。
In Zhengde 7 they repaired the dikes at the mouth of Guangping's Fuyang River. In the fourteenth year they dredged the right branch of Nanjing's Xinjiangkou. In the fifteenth year Censor Cheng Ying reported: "Garrison farmland of Yingtian and other guards on the north bank at Chu, He, and Liuhe lies so low that floods ruin it year after year. If we dredged the old channel from Jincheng Harbor through Zhuohe to Wujiang—more than thirty li—the flood would drain off and the garrison fields would prosper. " The emperor approved.
50
嘉靖元年，築浚束鹿、肥鄉、獻、魏堤渠。 初，蘇、鬆水道盡為勢家所據。 巡撫李充嗣畫水為井地，示開鑿法，戶佔一區，計工刻日。 造浚川爬，用巨筏數百，曳木齒，隨潮進退，擊汰泥沙。 置小艇百餘，尾鐵帚以導之。 浚故道，穿新渠，巨浦支流，罔不灌注。 帝嘉其勞，賚以銀幣。 二年，修德勝門東、朝陽門北城垣河道，築儀真、江都官塘五區。
In Jiajing 1 they built and dredged the dikes and canals of Shulu, Feixiang, Xian, and Wei. Earlier, powerful families had seized control of Suzhou and Songjiang's waterways. Grand Coordinator Li Chongsi laid the channels out in a well-field grid, published digging methods, and assigned each household a section with a fixed quota and deadline. He built river-dredging harrows: hundreds of large rafts dragged wooden rakes with the tide, scouring silt as they advanced and retreated. More than a hundred small boats followed, iron brooms at their sterns to guide the harrows. They dredged old channels and cut new ones until every main stream and tributary flowed again. The emperor praised his efforts and rewarded him with silver. In the second year they repaired the moat channels east of Desheng Gate and north of Chaoyang Gate, and built five sections of the official causeway at Yizhen and Jiangdu.
51
十年，工部郎中陸時雍言：「良鄉盧溝河，涿州琉璃、胡良二河，新城、雄縣白溝河，河間沙河，青縣滹沱河，下流皆淤。 宜以時浚，使達於海。 」詔巡撫議之。
In the tenth year Director Lu Shiyong of the Ministry of Works reported: "The Lugou at Liangxiang, the Liuli and Huliang at Zhuozhou, the Baigou at Xincheng and Xiong, the Sha at Hejian, and the Hutuo at Qing—all are choked downstream. They should be dredged on schedule so each can reach the sea again. " The court told the grand coordinator to study the plan.
52
十一年，太僕卿何棟勘畿封河患有二。 一論滹沱河。 其一言：「真定鴨、沙、磁三河，俱發源五臺。 會諸支水，抵唐河蘭家圈，合流入河間。 東南經任丘、霸州、天津入海，此故道也。 河間東南高，東北下，故水決蘭家口，而肅寧、新安皆罹其害。 宜築決口，浚故道。 涿州胡良河，自拒馬分流，至州東入渾河。 良鄉琉璃河，發源磁家務，潛入地中，至良鄉東入渾河。 比者渾河壅塞，二河不流。 然下流淤沙僅四五里，請亟浚之。 」部覆允行。
In the eleventh year Minister He Dong of the Court of Imperial Studs surveyed capital-region river troubles and identified two problems. The first concerned the Hutuo. On the first he wrote: "Zhending's Ya, Sha, and Ci rivers all rise on Wutai Mountain. Their branches converge at Lanjia Quan on the Tang River and flow on into Hejian. From there the old course ran southeast through Renqiu, Bazhou, and Tianjin to the sea. Hejian is higher to the southeast and lower to the northeast, so the river burst at Lanjia Mouth and Suning and Xin'an were inundated. We should close the breach and reopen the old channel. Zhuozhou's Huliang branches from the Juma, runs to the east of the prefecture, and enters the Hun. Liangxiang's Liuli rises at Cijiawu, runs underground, and emerges east of Liangxiang to join the Hun. Lately the Hun has silted up and neither river runs. Yet downstream the blockage is only four or five li—please dredge it at once. " The ministry approved and ordered the work carried out.
53
郎中徐元祉受命振災，上言：「河本以泄水，今反下壅； 澱本以瀦水，今反上溢。 故畿輔常苦水，順天利害相半，真定利多於害，保定害多於利，河間全受其害。 弘、正間，嘗築長堤，排決口，旋即潰敗。 今惟疏浚可施，其策凡六。 一浚本河，俾河身寬邃。 九河自山西來者，南合滹沱而不侵真定諸郡，北合白溝而不侵保定諸郡。 此第一義也。 一浚支河。 令九河之流，經大清河，從紫城口入； 經文都村，從涅槃口入； 經白洋澱，從蘭家口入； 經章哥ＡＨ，從楊村河入。 直遂以納細流，水力分矣。 一浚決河。 九河安流時，本支二河可受，遇漲則岸口四沖。 宜每衝量存一口，復浚令合成一渠，以殺湍急，備淫溢。 一浚澱河。 令澱澱相通，達於本支二河，使下有所泄。 一浚淤河。 九河東逝，悉由故道，高者下，下者通。 佔據曲防者抵罪。 一浚下河。 九河一出青縣，一出丁字沽，二流相匝於苑家口。 故施工必自苑家口始，漸有成效，然後次第舉行，庶減諸郡水害。 」帝嘉納之。
Director Xu Yuanzhi, charged with disaster relief, memorialized: "Rivers exist to carry water off, yet now they back up downstream; marshes exist to store water, yet now they spill upstream. That is why the capital region is chronically flooded: Shuntian sees equal gain and loss, Zhending gains more than it loses, Baoding loses more than it gains, and Hejian bears the full brunt. Under Hongzhi and Zhengde they built long dikes and sealed breaches, only to see them fail at once. Only dredging will serve now; he offered six measures. First, dredge the main channel until the river is wide and deep. Let the Nine Rivers from Shanxi join the Hutuo on the south without flooding Zhending, and the Baigou on the north without flooding Baoding. That is the first principle. Second, clear the branch channels. Route the Nine Rivers through the Daqing, in at Zicheng Mouth; through Wendu village, in at Niepan Mouth; through Baiyang Marsh, in at Lanjia Mouth; through Zhangge Marsh, in at the Yangcun River. Each run should be straight and swift to take the lesser flows and divide the force of the flood. Third, manage the breach channels. When the Nine Rivers run calm, the main and branch channels can hold them; when they swell, water bursts the banks in every direction. At each breakout keep one outlet, dredge them into a single channel, and slow the torrent before it spills everywhere. Fourth, dredge the marsh channels. Link the marshes to one another and to the main and branch rivers so the lowlands have somewhere to drain. Fifth, clear silted channels. Let the Nine Rivers running east follow their old beds—cut down the high, open the low. Anyone who blocks the course with private dikes shall be punished. Sixth, dredge the lower reaches. One Nine River arm leaves Qing county, another leaves Dingzigou; the two meet and circle at Yuanjiakou. Work must therefore begin at Yuanjiakou; only after results appear there should the rest proceed in turn, easing flood across the prefectures. " The emperor approved the plan with praise.
54
明年，香河郭家莊自開新河一道，長百七十丈，闊五十丈，近舊河十里餘。 詔河官亟繕治。
The following year at Guojiazhuang in Xianghe a new channel opened on its own—one hundred seventy zhang long and fifty wide—running parallel to the old river more than ten li away. The court ordered river officials to repair it at once.
55
十三年，巡撫都御史周金言：「蘭家圈決口，塞之則東溢，病河間； 不塞則東流漸淤，病保定。 宜存決口而浚廣新河，使水東北平流，無壅涸患。 」從之。
In the thirteenth year Grand Coordinator Zhou Jin reported: "At the breach in Lanjia Quan, sealing it floods Hejian to the east; leaving it open lets the eastern channel silt up and harms Baoding. We should keep the breach open and widen the new channel so water runs evenly east and north without choking or drying out. " The court agreed.
56
二十四年，浚南京後湖。 初，胡體乾按吳，以松江泛溢，進六策：「曰開川，曰浚湖，曰殺上流之勢，曰決下流之壑，曰排潮漲之沙，曰立治田之規。 是年，呂光洵按吳，復奏蘇、鬆水利五事：
In the twenty-fourth year they dredged Nanjing's Rear Lake. Earlier, while inspecting Wu, Hu Tigian had proposed six remedies for Songjiang's chronic flooding: open main channels, dredge lakes, ease upstream pressure, clear downstream outlets, flush away tidal silt, and set rules for field management. That same year Lü Guangxun, inspecting Wu, memorialized five points on Suzhou and Songjiang water works:
57
一曰廣疏浚以備瀦泄。 三吳澤國，西南受太湖諸澤，水勢尤卑。 東北際海，岡隴之地，視西南特高。 高苦旱，卑苦澇。 昔人於下流疏為塘浦，導諸湖水北入江，東入海，又引江潮流衍於岡隴外。 瀦泄有法，水旱無患。 比來縱浦橫塘，多堙不治，惟黃浦、劉河二江頗通。 然太湖之水源多勢盛，二江不足以泄之。 岡隴支河又多壅絕，無以資灌溉。 於是高下俱病，歲常告災。 宜先度要害，於氵殿山等茭蘆地，導太湖水散入陽城、昆承、三泖等湖。 又開吳淞江及大石、趙屯等浦，泄澱山之水以達於海。 浚白茆、鯰魚諸口，泄昆承之水以注於江。 開七浦、鹽鐵等塘，泄陽城之水以達於江。 又導田間之水，悉入小浦，以納大浦，使流者皆有所歸，瀦者皆有所泄。 則下流之地治，而澇無所憂矣。 乃浚艾祁、通波以溉青浦，浚顧浦、吳塘以溉嘉定，浚大瓦等浦以溉崑山之東，浚許浦等塘以溉常熟之北，浚臧村等港以溉金壇，浚澡港等河以溉武進。 凡隴岡支河堙塞不治者，皆浚之深廣，使復其舊。 則上流之地亦治，而旱無所憂矣。 此三吳水利之經也。
First, dredge broadly to secure both storage and release. The Three Wu form a water country: the southwest takes Tai Lake and its feeder marshes, and the land lies especially low. To the northeast lies the sea, where ridges and mounds stand far higher than the southwest. The high ground thirsts in drought; the low drowns in flood. The ancients cut embanked creeks on the lower reaches to send lake water north into the Yangtze and east into the sea, and led tidal water from the Yangtze onto the higher ground beyond the ridges. With proper storage and release, flood and drought ceased to be a scourge. Lately creeks and cross-dikes have been neglected until most are choked; only the Huangpu and Liuhe remain fairly clear. Yet Tai Lake has many sources and tremendous volume—two rivers cannot carry it off. Branch channels through the uplands were again choked shut, leaving no water for irrigation. High ground and low ground alike fell ill, and almost every year brought disaster reports. They should first survey the choke points and, at Dianshan and other reed flats, channel Tai Lake water into Yangcheng, Kun-Cheng, and the Three Mo lakes. Open the Wusong River and creeks such as Dashi and Zhaotun to carry off Dianshan's waters to the sea. Dredge the mouths at Baimao, Nianyu, and elsewhere to send Kun-Cheng's waters down to the Yangtze. Open the Qipu, Yantie, and other channel-ponds to carry Yangcheng's waters to the Yangtze. Field runoff should be led into minor creeks and then into major ones, so every current had an outlet and every pool a drain. The lowlands would then be brought under control, and flooding would cease to be a threat. Dredge the Aiqi and Tongbo channels to water Qingpu; Gupu and Wutang for Jiading; Dawapu and like channels for eastern Kunshan; Xupu and similar ponds for northern Changshu; Zangcun and other harbors for Jintan; Zaogang and other rivers for Wujin. Every choked branch channel through the uplands should be dredged deep and wide until restored to its former capacity. The highlands too would be secured, and drought would cease to be a threat. Such was the enduring canon of hydraulic policy in the Three Wu region.
58
一曰修圩岸以固橫流。 蘇、鬆、常、鎮東南下流，而蘇、鬆又常、鎮下流，易瀦難泄。 雖導河浚浦引注江海，而秋霖泛漲，風濤相薄，則河浦之水逆行田間，沖齧為患。 宋轉運使王純臣嘗令蘇、湖作田塍禦水，民甚便之。 司農丞郟亦云：「治河以治田為本。 」故老皆云，前二三十年，民間足食，因餘力治圩岸，田益完美。 近皆空乏，無暇修繕，故田圩漸壞，歲多水災。 合敕所在官司專治圩岸。 岸高則田自固，雖有霖澇，不能為害。 且足制諸湖之水鹹歸河浦中，則不待決泄，自然湍流。 而岡隴之地，亦因江水稍高，又得畝引以資灌溉，不特利於低田而已。
Second, restore polder dikes to hold back lateral currents. Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang drain southeastward; Suzhou and Songjiang lie below Changzhou and Zhenjiang, where water ponds easily and drains with difficulty. Even with rivers dredged and channels led to the Yangtze and sea, autumn floods and wind-driven surges could drive water back through the fields, scouring the land. During the Song, Transport Commissioner Wang Chunchen had Suzhou and the lake districts build field ridges against floodwater, to great popular benefit. Ministry aide Xing Yun also said, "River work must take field work as its foundation. " The elders all recalled that twenty or thirty years earlier the people ate their fill and, with labor to spare, kept the polder dikes in repair until the farmland grew ever more perfect. Lately households were impoverished, with no time for maintenance; polders decayed and flood disasters came year after year. An edict should order every local office to maintain the polder dikes as its dedicated duty. High dikes would keep the fields secure; even in torrential seasons they would suffer little harm. They would also confine lake brine within the channel network, so water would race through without emergency breaches. Upland fields could draw the slightly higher river water acre by acre for irrigation—not a benefit confined to the lowlands alone.
59
一曰復板閘以防汙氵殿。 河浦之水皆自平原流入江海，水慢潮急，以故沙隨浪湧，其勢易淤。 昔人權其便宜，去江海十里許夾流為閘，隨潮啟閉，以禦淤沙。 歲旱則長閉以蓄其流，歲澇則長啟以宣其溢，所謂置閘有三利，蓋謂此也。 近多堙塞，惟常熟福山閘尚存。 故老以為河浦入海之地，誠皆置閘，自可曆久不壅。
Third, restore plank sluice gates to hold back silt deposition. Channel water moved sluggishly from the plain toward river and sea while the tide ran swift, so sand surged with the waves and silt built up easily. Forebears had weighed convenience and built sluice gates roughly ten li from the estuary, opening and closing with the tide to hold back silt. In drought the gates stayed shut to hoard water; in flood they stayed open to discharge the surplus—the "three benefits of sluice gates" meant precisely this. Most had since silted shut; only the Fushan sluice at Changshu remained. The elders held that if sluices were restored at every estuary, the channels could stay clear for years on end.
60
一曰量緩急以處工費。
Fourth, gauge urgency and ease when allocating labor and funds.
61
一曰重委任以責成功。
Fifth, invest officials with real authority and hold them accountable for results.
62
詔悉如議。 光洵因請專委巡撫歐陽必進。 從之。 二十六年，給事中陳斐請仿江南水田法，開江北溝洫，以祛水患，益歲收。 報可。
The emperor approved the entire proposal. Lü Guangxun asked that overall responsibility be given to Grand Coordinator Ouyang Bijing. His request was granted. In year 26, Supervising Secretary Chen Fei proposed adopting Jiangnan paddy methods to open ditches and canals in northern Jiangsu, easing floods and raising the harvest. Approved.
63
三十八年，總督尚書楊博請開宣、大荒田水利。 從之。 巡撫都御史翁大立言：「東吳水利，自震澤浚源以注江，三江導流以入海，而蘇州三十六浦，松江八匯，毘陵十四瀆，共以節宣旱澇。 近因倭寇衝突，汊港之交，率多釘柵築堤以為捍禦，因致水流停瀦，淤滓日積。 管道之間，仰高成阜。 且具區湖泖，並水而居者雜蒔茭蘆，積泥成蕩，民間又多自起圩岸。 上流日微，水勢日殺。 黃浦、婁江之水又為舟師所居，下流亦淤。 海潮無力，水利難興，民田漸磽。 宜於吳淞、白茆、七浦等處造成石閘，啟閉以時。 挑鎮江、常州漕河深廣，使輸挽無阻，公私之利也。 」詔可。
In year 38, supreme commissioner Yang Bo memorialized to develop waterworks for wasteland in Xuanzhou and Dazhou. Granted. Grand Coordinator Weng Dali reported, "Eastern Wu hydrology began with dredging Lake Tai's headwaters into the Yangtze and the Three Rivers' discharge to the sea; Suzhou's thirty-six creeks, Songjiang's eight confluences, and Piling's fourteen channels together balanced drought and flood. Lately, wokou raids had led people to spike harbors and throw up dikes for defense, so currents stalled, silt piled up daily, and channel beds rose into embankments. Around Lake Tai and the marshes, waterside residents planted reeds and rushes until mud piled into shallows, while countless private polder dikes sprang up. Upstream flow dwindled daily and hydraulic force weakened. The Huangpu and Lou River were choked by naval moorings, and downstream silted as well. With the tides too weak to scour the channels, waterworks languished and farmland turned ever stonier. Stone sluice gates should be built at Wusong, Baimao, Qipu, and the like, opened and closed according to season. The grain canals at Zhenjiang and Changzhou should be dredged deep and wide so transport would run unimpeded—a gain for state and subject alike. " Approved.
64
四十二年，給事中張憲臣言：「蘇、鬆、常、嘉、湖五郡水患疊見。 請浚支河，通潮水； 築圩岸，禦湍流。 其白茆港、劉家河、七浦、楊林及凡河渠河蕩壅淤沮洳者，悉宜疏導。 」帝以江南久苦倭患，民不宜重勞，令酌浚支河而已。 四十五年，參政淩雲翼請專設御史督蘇、鬆水利。 詔巡鹽御史兼之。
In year 42, Supervising Secretary Zhang Xianchen reported, "Floods had struck Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou in succession. He asked that branch channels be dredged and tidal flow restored; and polder dikes built to beat back surging currents. Baimao Harbor, the Liujia River, Qipu, Yanglin, and every choked ditch and marsh should be cleared. " The emperor, mindful that Jiangnan had long endured wokou raids and the people could bear no heavy labor, authorized dredging of branch channels alone. In year 45, Vice Commissioner Ling Yunyi asked for a dedicated censor to oversee Suzhou-Songjiang hydrology. The salt-route censor was ordered to take on the duty as well.
65
隆慶三年，開湖廣竹筒河以泄漢江。 巡撫都御史海瑞疏吳淞江下流上海淤地萬四千丈有奇。 江面舊三十丈，增開十五丈，自黃渡至宋家橋長八十里。 明年春，瑞言：「三吳入海之道，南止吳淞，北止白茆，中止劉河。 劉河通達無滯，吳淞方在挑疏。 土人請開白茆，計浚五千餘丈，役夫百六十四萬餘。 」又言：「吳淞役垂竣，惟東西二壩未開。 父老皆言崑山夏駕口、吳江長橋、長洲寶帶橋、吳縣胥口及凡可通流下吳淞者，逐一挑畢，方可開壩。 」並從之。 是年築海鹽海塘。 越四年，從巡撫侍郎徐栻議，復開海鹽秦駐山，南至澉浦舊河。
Longqing 3: the Bamboo-tube River in Huguang was opened to relieve the Han River. Grand Coordinator Hai Rui reported more than fourteen thousand zhang of silt along the lower Wusong at Shanghai. The channel, formerly thirty zhang wide, was widened by fifteen zhang from Huangdu to Songjia Bridge—a stretch of eighty li. The following spring Hai Rui wrote, "The Three Wu had three outlets to the sea: Wusong in the south, Baimao in the north, and Liuhe in the middle. Liuhe was open throughout; Wusong was still being dredged. Locals petitioned to open Baimao—some five thousand zhang of dredging and more than 1.64 million labor-days. " He added that the Wusong work was nearly done but the eastern and western dams remained closed. Elders insisted that Xiadjiakou in Kunshan, Chang Bridge in Wujiang, Baodai Bridge in Changzhou, Xukou in Wuxian, and every outlet feeding the Wusong be cleared first—only then could the dams be opened. All was approved. That year the Haiyan seadike was built. Four years later, on Vice Commissioner Xu Zhi's advice, the channel from Qinzhushan in Haiyan south to the old Ganpu river was reopened.
66
萬曆二年，築荊州採穴，承天泗港、謝家灣諸決堤口。 復築荊、嶽等府及鬆滋諸縣老垸堤。
Wanli 2: breach closures were built at Jingzhou's Caiyue, Chengtian's Sigang, Xiejiawan, and elsewhere. Old polder dikes were also restored in Jingzhou, Yuezhou, and other prefectures and in Songzi and neighboring counties.
67
四年，巡撫都御史宋儀望言：「三吳水勢，東南自嘉、秀沿海而北，皆趨松江，循黃浦入海； 西北自常、鎮沿江而東，皆趨江陰、常熟。 其中太湖瀦蓄，匯為巨浸，流注龐山、瀆墅、澱山、三泖，陽城諸湖。 乃開浦引湖，北經常熟七浦、白茆諸港入於江，東北經崑山、太倉穿劉家河，東南通吳淞江、黃浦，各入於海。 諸水聯絡，四面環護，中如仰盂。 杭、嘉湖、常、鎮勢繞四隅，蘇州居中，松江為諸水所受，最居下。 乞專設水利僉事以裨國計。 」部議遣御史董之。
In year 4, Grand Coordinator Song Yiwang wrote, "In the Three Wu, waters from Jiaxing and Xiuzhou along the coast trend north to Songjiang and out through the Huangpu; from Changzhou and Zhenjiang along the Yangtze they trend east toward Jiangyin and Changshu. Tai Lake impounds the surplus into a vast sheet that feeds Pangshan, Dushu, Dianshan, the Three Mo, Yangcheng, and other lakes. Creeks draw the lakes north through Changshu's Qipu and Baimao into the Yangtze, northeast through Kunshan and Taicang via the Liujia River, and southeast through the Wusong and Huangpu to the sea. The waters interlock, ringed on every side, the basin like an upturned bowl. Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Huzhou, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang rim the four corners; Suzhou sits in the middle; Songjiang, lowest of all, receives every stream. He asked that a dedicated hydrology intendant be appointed to strengthen state revenue. " The ministry agreed to send a censor to supervise.
68
六年，巡撫都御史胡執禮請先浚吳淞江長橋、黃浦。 先是，巡按御史林應訓言：
In year 6, Grand Coordinator Hu Zhili asked that the Wusong at Chang Bridge and the Huangpu be dredged first. Earlier, Investigating Censor Lin Yingxun had reported:
69
「蘇、鬆水利在開吳淞江中段，以通入海之勢。 太湖入海，其道有三：東北由劉河，即古婁江故道； 東南由大黃浦，即古東江遺意； 其中為吳淞江，經崑山、嘉定、青浦、上海，乃太湖正脈。 今劉河、黃浦皆通，而中江獨塞者，蓋江流與海潮遇，海潮渾濁，賴江水迅滌之。 劉河獨受巴、陽諸湖，又有新洋江、夏駕浦從旁以注； 大黃浦總會杭、嘉之水，又有澱山、泖蕩從上而灌。 是以流皆清駛，足以敵潮，不能淤也。
"Suzhou-Songjiang hydrology depends on opening the middle reach of the Wusong so the lake may pour to the sea. Tai Lake has three outlets: northeast via Liuhe, the old course of the Lou River; southeast via the Great Huangpu, heir to the ancient Eastern River; and between them the Wusong through Kunshan, Jiading, Qingpu, and Shanghai—the lake's main artery. Liuhe and the Huangpu stay clear, yet the middle channel alone silts up: where river meets tide the seawater is muddy and only a swift freshwater current can scour it. Liuhe draws the Ba and Yang lakes and gains the Xinyang River and Xiadjiapu besides; the Great Huangpu collects Hangzhou and Jiaxing and is fed from above by Dianshan and the Mo marshes. Their currents run clear and fast enough to beat the tide and resist silting.
70
惟吳淞江源出長橋、石塘下，經龐山、九里二湖而入。 今長橋、石塘已堙，龐山、九里復為灘漲，其來已微。 又有新洋江、夏駕浦掣其水以入劉河，勢乃益弱，不能勝海潮洶湧之勢而滌濁渾之流，日積月累，淤塞僅留一線。 水失故道，時致淫濫。 支河小港，亦復壅滯。 舊熟之田，半成荒畝。
The Wusong alone rises below Chang Bridge and Shitang and passes through Pangshan and Jiuli lakes. Chang Bridge and Shitang are choked; Pangshan and Jiuli have silted into shallows; the inflow is feeble. The Xinyang and Xiadjiapu further divert water into Liuhe, weakening the current until it cannot scour the muddy tide; month by month the channel shrank to a thread. Water lost its proper course and floods broke out repeatedly. Branch channels and creeks silted up as well. Half the once-fertile fields lay waste.
71
前都御史海瑞力破羣議，挑自上海江口宋家橋至嘉定艾祁八十里，幸尚通流。 自艾祁至崑山慢水港六十餘里，則俱漲灘，急宜開浚，計淺九千五百餘丈，闊二十丈。 此江一開，太湖直入於海，濱江諸渠得以引流灌田，青浦積荒之區俱可開墾成熟矣。」
Former minister Hai Rui had defied widespread opposition and dredged eighty li from Songjia Bridge at Shanghai to Aiqi in Jiading; that stretch still flowed. From Aiqi to Manshui Harbor in Kunshan—sixty-odd li of shoals—must be opened at once: some nine thousand five hundred zhang to deepen to twenty zhang wide. Open that reach and Tai Lake would pour straight to the sea; coastal channels could irrigate the fields, and Qingpu's long-fallow land could be brought back under the plow."
72
並從之。 至是，工成。 應訓又言：
All was approved. The work was finished. Lin Yingxun added:
73
「吳江縣治居太湖正東，湖水由此下吳淞達海。 宋時運道所經，畏風阻險，乃建長橋、石塘以通牽挽。 長橋百三十丈，為洞六十有二。 石塘小則有竇，大則有橋，內外浦涇縱橫貫穿，皆為泄水計也。 石塘涇竇半淤，長橋內外俱圮，僅一二洞門通水。 若不疏浚，雖開吳淞下流，終無益也。 宜開龐山湖口，由長橋抵吳家港。 則湖有所泄，江有所歸，源盛流長，為利大矣。
"Wujiang's seat lies directly east of Tai Lake; its waters descend the Wusong to the sea. When the Song grain route passed this way, fear of wind and shoals led them to build Chang Bridge and Shitang for towing haulers. Chang Bridge spans one hundred thirty zhang and has sixty-two arch openings. Along Shitang, small sections have sluice openings and large ones have bridges; creeks and canals crisscross within and without, all designed to let water off. Shitang's channels and culverts are half choked with silt; Chang Bridge is ruined on both sides, and only one or two arch openings still carry water. Without dredging here, opening the lower Wusong would do no good in the end. Pangshan Lake's outlet should be opened, with a channel from Chang Bridge to Wujia Harbor. The lake would drain, the river would have a proper course, sources would run strong and long—and the benefit would be immense.
74
松江大黃浦西南受杭、嘉之水，西北受氵殿、泖諸蕩之水，總會於浦，而秀州塘、山涇港諸處實黃浦來源也。 氵殿山湖入黃浦道漸多淤淺，宜為疏瀹。 而自黃浦、橫澇、洙涇，經秀州塘入南泖，至山涇港等處，萬四千餘丈，待浚尤急。
Songjiang's Great Huangpu takes in Hangzhou and Jiaxing waters from the southwest and Dianshan, Mo, and other lagoon waters from the northwest, all gathering in the channel; yet Xiuzhou Canal, Shanjing Harbor, and the like are the Huangpu's true headwaters.
